Eligibility Criteria

* Minimum

  **Validation and Verification Body (VVB)**

A proactive professional who combines technical understanding of carbon projects with consulting capabilities, client engagement skills, and an interest in contributing to the growth of carbon markets and climate solutions.

title: WAM-BA-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Business Analyst / Data & AI Consultant Wealth & Asset Management**
**Senior Business Analyst / Data & AI Consultant**
**Experience**

* 5-8 years

**Role Focus**

* Hands-on BA execution, data analysis, requirements, SQL, APIs

**Primary Output**

* BRD, FRD, user stories, data mappings, test scenarios

**AI Focus**

* AI-assisted analysis and documentation

**Stakeholder Level**

* Business users, product owners, technology, QA, data teams

**Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to support data-led technology initiatives across Wealth & Asset Management and Capital Markets. The role will focus on requirements analysis, data mapping, SQL-based investigation, API understanding, documentation, testing support, and close collaboration with business and technology teams. The candidate will contribute to solutions involving consolidated order/trade data stores, multiple asset classes, system integrations, workflow design, and data-flow analysis.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Gather, interpret, and document business, functional, technical, and data requirements from written inputs and stakeholder discussions.
* Analyze order, trade, portfolio, client, reference, market, and reporting data across multiple systems and business lines.
* Create BRDs, FRDs, FSD inputs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data mappings, and data dictionaries.
* Perform source-to-target data mapping, field-level analysis, data profiling, SQL investigation, data validation, and reconciliation checks.
* Work with technology teams to clarify database requirements, API expectations, JSON/XML payloads, integration points, and downstream data needs.
* Support development and QA teams by explaining requirements, resolving clarifications, reviewing test scenarios, and validating test coverage.
* Facilitate SIT/UAT support, defect analysis, issue tracking, remediation follow-up, and business sign-off coordination.
* Use Agile practices to support backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and workstream status updates.
* Use GenAI tools responsibly to accelerate requirements drafting, analysis summaries, test preparation, data investigation, and documentation quality.
* Translate technical concepts into business language and business requirements into technology-ready specifications.

**Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Technology Consultant.
* Experience in Financial Services, with preference for Wealth Management, Asset Management, Capital Markets, trading systems, investment platforms, or reporting platforms.
* Good understanding of order/trade lifecycle and one or more asset classes such as equities, options, fixed income, mutual funds, ETFs, structured products, derivatives, or alternatives.
* Hands-on experience with data mapping, data analysis, data validation, reconciliation, data migration, and data-quality issue investigation.
* Strong SQL skills for querying, data checks, root-cause analysis, and reconciliation support.
* Understanding of REST APIs, web services, JSON/XML payloads, Postman, and system integration concepts.
* Experience creating BRDs, FRDs, user stories, functional requirements, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Jira or similar ALM tools, and documentation tools such as Confluence.
* Practical AI-native mindset with ability to use tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure AI, or similar platforms to improve productivity and quality.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* WAM and Capital Markets domain knowledge across front, middle, and back-office processes.
* Data mapping, data lineage, source-to-target analysis, data profiling, and data reconciliation.
* Advanced SQL querying and ability to investigate data issues independently.
* API and web-service understanding, including request/response structures and testing support through Postman or similar tools.
* Requirements documentation including BRD, FRD, FSD inputs, user stories, acceptance criteria, data dictionaries, mapping specifications, and process flows.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to work on multiple project tasks or workstreams with guidance from project leads or managers.

**Experience And Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in business analysis, data analysis, technology consulting, financial services transformation, or related roles.
* Certifications such as CBAP, Agile/Scrum, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, or AI-related certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.
  
  
The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
* Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
* Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
* Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
* Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
* Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
* Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
* Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 Months
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.
  
  
In 6 Months
  
  
Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
  
  
In 12 Months
  
  
Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) strives to provide the company with transparent, proactive insights into process and control effectiveness that are used for managing risk, policy adherence, and driving operational excellence. EIT tests processes and controls throughout the year on behalf of Frontline Units (FLUs), Control Functions (CFs), and Global Risk Management to enable them to manage their processes and controls more effectively. EIT also participates in regular reviews, examinations, and routines with regulators, as well as Corporate Audit.
  
  
**Job Description\***
**TEST DEVELOPMENT AND TEST AUTOMATION (TD) IC**
The Test Development and automation role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive test procedures to evaluate control effectiveness, and looking for test automation feasibility and execution.
  
  
The role requires collaboration with stakeholders to translate business, regulatory, and process requirements into structured, repeatable test scripts, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency of testing outcomes, as well as checking for usable automated workflows . The role operates within a structured framework, ensuring all development activities are executed, tracked, and governed through a centralized system of record, including milestone tracking, documentation, and status reporting.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in test development, test execution, QA/QC, and test automation, with strong analytical, data, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Design and develop test scripts aligned to EIT standards
* Assess test steps and data sources to identify repeatable, rules-based automation opportunities
* Design, build, test, and maintain automated test scripts or workflows aligned to EIT standards
* Define input data, business rules, expected results, exception handling, and reconciliation checks for automated tests
* Validate automated outputs against approved test procedures before deployment and after material changes
* Translate business and control requirements into structured, repeatable test scenarios
* Execute activities across the end-to-end Test Development Life Cycle (TDLC)
* Ensure all development activities are accurately tracked in the system of record, with timely status updates and progression
* Prepare and maintain attestation evidence and deliverables, ensuring alignment to defined acceptance criteria prior to closure
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Test Execution, QA, and Risk teams to ensure seamless workflow progression
* Identify, document, and escalate defects, control gaps, and process issues
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), testing standards, and quality benchmarks
* Adhere to defined SLAs, timelines, and quality benchmarks
* Monitor automation performance, investigate failures, and maintain documentation, evidence, and change history
* Contribute to continuous improvement and testing transformation initiatives

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Graduate / Postgraduate in
  
  

* Business / Commerce / Banking
* Finance / Risk / Operations
* Technology or related disciplines

**Experience Range\***
4–6 years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet defined SLAs
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to develop integrated solutions
* Strong data-analysis capability using Excel and query tools to profile, reconcile, and validate test populations
* Ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive test requirements and scenarios
* Strong understanding of test design, test lifecycle management, automation feasibility, and control validation
* Hands-on ability to develop and troubleshoot automated tests using SQL, Python, or equivalent approved automation tools
* Ability to convert manual test logic into reusable automation with defined inputs, rules, expected outputs, and exceptions
* Understanding of automation controls, including validation, access management, version control, change management, and audit evidence
* Ability to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency in testing outputs
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills
* Understanding of structured test lifecycle frameworks (e.g., TDLC or equivalent)
* Minimum 2+ years of experience in testing, risk management, process improvement, compliance, or front-line control roles demonstrating strong analytical capability
* Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in Test Development, Test Execution, QA/QC, or test automation
* Understanding and awareness of AI/other emerging technologies

**Desired Skills**

* Working knowledge of data warehousing and data mining concepts, with basic understanding of SAS/SQL query languages
* Experience in writing queries to extract and analyze data from multiple data sources (e.g., DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Hadoop, Hive)

**Work Timings\***
12:30 PM to 9:30 PM (IST); As per business requirement (flexibility to support global stakeholders)
  
  
**Job Location\***
GIFT/HYD City

This position partners with Quality, R&D, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Global Product Cybersecurity, Regulatory Affairs, Design Assurance, Post-Market Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity risks and deliverables are appropriately identified, assessed, controlled, verified, documented, and maintained.

The individual will also strengthen organizational cybersecurity capability by developing consistent approaches, reusable knowledge assets, and technical expertise within the Quality organization.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Serve as the Quality subject matter expert for product cybersecurity activities across new product development, sustaining engineering, product changes, remediation, and integration programs.
* Provide independent Quality review and approval of cybersecurity plans, assessments, reports, and other lifecycle deliverables in accordance with applicable Quality System requirements.
* Review cybersecurity risk analyses, threat models, security architectures, attack-surface assessments, and risk-control strategies for completeness, consistency, technical adequacy, and traceability.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks, requirements, controls, and verification evidence are appropriately connected across design controls, software lifecycle documentation, system requirements, and product risk-management files.
* Review Software Bills of Materials, MDS2 documentation, cybersecurity reports, penetration-test results, static and dynamic analysis results, vulnerability assessments, and security verification evidence.
* Assess the cybersecurity quality impact of design changes, software changes, third-party software updates, operating-system changes, supplier changes, and other product lifecycle changes.

title: Financial Systems Analyst II
description:
**Job Description**
As part of the Financial Reporting Quality Assurance (FRQA) organization within Corporate Controllership, this role is accountable for overseeing critical Level 1 production support processes for financial systems, including data sourcing, ingestion, transformation, validation, operational calendar management, end-to-end process coordination, and incident management.
  
  
The team maintains deep knowledge of data sources, processing workflows, and regulatory reporting requirements, and is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents across a broad range of finance technology platforms. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, financial acumen, disciplined operational execution, proactive monitoring, and timely incident resolution.
  
  
The Service Management Financial System Analyst is expected to be collaborative, highly organized, and results oriented, with responsibility for end-to-end operational monitoring, incident tracking, triage, problem management, and support of financial system reliability, stability, and performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role is responsible for ensuring financial systems operations are effectively governed, executed, monitored, controlled, and continuously improved. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Manage operational processes to ensure financial systems function as intended, processes run efficiently, and required controls and auditability are maintained.
* Ensure successful completion of daily operational activities in alignment with established processing calendars, controls, and service expectations.
* Collaborate with business, finance, and technology stakeholders to triage incidents, manage resolution activities, and support timely root cause analysis.
* Identify recurring incident themes and partner with technology and business teams to drive sustainable remediation and reduce operational risk.
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, standardization, and automation.
* Assess the operational impact of production changes and ensure runbooks, procedures, and related documentation are updated accurately and on time.
* Develop, operationalize, and monitor dashboards that provide transparency into process health, operational performance, and service management trends.
* Document business and technical requirements for enhancements, standard operating procedures, and process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and control management requirements.
* Identify, document, implement, and periodically test operational controls in accordance with RCSA/PRSA guidelines to confirm control effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technology-related field, preferably Computer Science.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial systems implementation, production support, and incident management for financial systems.
* Advanced knowledge of relational database and data management concepts, with strong proficiency in SQL and exposure to both traditional and modern data technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial, business, and technology concepts for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and consistently meet critical deadlines.
* Ability to perform effectively in a high-pressure environment and make sound decisions in challenging situations.
* Proven transformational mindset, with a focus on improving process efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Self-starter and proactive team player with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality service and meeting stakeholder expectations.
* Experience with accounting and reporting processes, including financial and regulatory reporting, is preferred.
* Flexibility is essential for this production support role, including the ability to work in shifts and provide weekend support on a rotational basis.

Technical Skills & Knowledge of Platforms
  
  

* Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and production incident troubleshooting, including the ability to write complex queries and perform multi-table joins.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, MemSQL, and Putty for incident triage, reporting, and operational support.
* Advanced knowledge of job scheduling tools such as Airflow and Automic is required.
* Experience in Generative AI frameworks would be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, monitoring, logging, IAM, production support, maintenance, and troubleshooting, is preferred.
* Experience with AxiomSL is preferred.
* Knowledge of Flink and Beam server is preferred.
* Experience with ServiceNow and Jira is preferred.

Job Opportunity

**Survey Programming Consultant**

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
  
  
A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role, as a senior consultant in GDS Consulting, you will lead the implementation of Ciena/ Blue Planet products and integration with the telecommunications operators’ Operations Support Systems (OSS). You will be responsible for ensuring that a quality, integrated software solution is delivered in a timely manner, at budget, and to our client's satisfaction.

* Write and optimize database queries and procedures, primarily for Neo4j, PostgreSQL.
* Support debugging, deployment, and environment setup using tools and platforms such as Docker, AWS, and Kubernetes.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

**Frontend Development:**

* Frameworks/Libraries: Angular 2+, Node.js/npm, Gulp
* Testing: Protractor, Jasmine

* Languages: Java 11+, J2EE
* Frameworks/Libraries: Maven, Spring (Data, Security, MVC), SpringBoot
* Testing: JUnit

**Databases:**

**Additional Skills:**

* ElasticSearch, Camunda / BPMN / OSM / Workflow, Drools, Kafka integration, RESTful APIs (using Spring MVC), Docker, Kubernetes
* Programming Concepts: Algorithms, data structures, database concepts (relational and graph)

* Consultant with minimum of 5+ Years proven experience and significant knowledge in Telecom OSS Network Inventory.
* Experience in Ciena Blue Planet Inventory (BPI).
* Experience in at least one of the OSS COTS products (E.g. Netcracker, Ericsson, Nokia, etc.)
* Knowledge of and preferably certification in TMForum’s eTOM framework along with Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and Open APIs.
* Exceptional quantitative skills enabling identification of key business issues and progression of solutions.

title: Senior Quality Engineer L1
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Associate, Quality Engineering - Level 1**
Publicis Sapient is looking for a Senior associate in quality engineering with strong functional and manual testing experience to help deliver high-quality technology solutions for our clients. You will apply your knowledge of capital markets, testing practices, APIs, and databases to validate complex trading applications across the development lifecycle. You will collaborate with developers, business stakeholders, and other quality engineers to identify risks, resolve defects, and improve product quality. Your testing expertise and problem-solving skills will contribute to reliable solutions that create meaningful value for our clients.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Plan and execute functional, manual, regression, and progression testing to ensure the quality and reliability of complex applications.
* Validate capital-markets workflows across the trading lifecycle, including order creation, execution, settlement, and related lifecycle events.
* Design comprehensive test scenarios covering Equities and Fixed Income instruments, including Bonds, Bond Forwards, Futures, and Swaps.
* Test REST and SOAP APIs by validating contracts, requests, responses, business fields, and error scenarios using tools such as Postman or curl.
* Write and execute SQL queries independently to validate application and test data across relevant database tables.
* Manage defects through their complete lifecycle, participate in defect triage, analyse application logs, and support root-cause investigation.
* Collaborate with developers, traders, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to complete testing activities and support successful releases.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience**
**:**

* 4+ years of hands-on functional or manual testing experience, preferably involving capital-markets or trading applications.
* Practical knowledge of the capital-markets trading lifecycle and experience testing Equities and Fixed Income products.
* Strong understanding of test planning, test-case design, estimation, regression testing, defect management, and test metrics.
* Working knowledge of REST and SOAP API testing, including request and response validation using Postman, curl, or similar tools.
* Ability to independently write SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, and GROUP BY.
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and participating in relevant sprint ceremonies.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently and drive assigned activities to completion.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With**
**:**

* Experience working with front-office or middle-office applications within an Asset Management organization.
* Exposure to test automation using Selenium with Java or Robot Framework with Python.
* Python scripting experience for test utilities, data validation, or simple automation.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions for test-case generation or defect analysis.

**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
*“Bring strong testing fundamentals, curiosity about capital markets, and the confidence to independently investigate complex issues.”*

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally-enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 5-7 years of experience in software quality engineering with hands-on expertise testing Java-based backend services and RESTful application programming interfaces
* Proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, RestAssured, or Cucumber for user interface and application programming interface testing
* Strong understanding of relational databases including PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server to perform data validation and verify data integrity across test scenarios
* Hands-on experience testing Anthropic Claude integrated features, including large language model output validation, semantic evaluation techniques, hallucination detection, and streaming application programming interface behavior
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol and agentic artificial intelligence testing patterns, including tool-use accuracy, context management, and deterministic versus non-deterministic output validation
* Experience with artificial intelligence security testing, including prompt injection testing, jailbreak validation, sensitive data leakage checks, and application reliability and performance assessments
* Strong understanding of software design principles and microservices architectures, with the ability to develop effective test strategies and identify system-level edge cases
* Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, with a track record of implementing advanced AI solutions to drive strategic transformation and operational efficiency. Strong experience using AI tools to lead innovation initiatives. Demonstrated leadership in managing AI-related risks, ensuring ethical governance, and fostering a culture of responsible AI adoption across the organization.

**Education**

* Bachelor or Master of Science in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field

**Responsibilities**
Lead quality engineering and artificial intelligence testing initiatives to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure software solutions across cloud-based platforms.
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for Java-based backend services and RESTful application programming interfaces to ensure high software quality across releases
* Own the test strategy for Anthropic Claude integrated features, including large language model output validation, regression baselines, tool-call accuracy verification, context management validation, and end-to-end integration coverage
* Build and maintain continuous integration integrated evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic artificial intelligence outputs, including rubric-based scoring, automated prompt regression suites, and behavioral drift detection
* Collaborate with product owners, software engineers, and machine learning engineers to define testable requirements, review acceptance criteria, and ensure high-quality delivery across agile releases
* Perform database validation testing against PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server environments to verify data integrity, transformation logic, and backend workflow accuracy
* Conduct artificial intelligence specific security testing, including prompt injection, adversarial input validation, jailbreak testing, and sensitive data leakage assessments aligned with Moody’s governance standards
* Define and enforce synthetic or masked test data standards for artificial intelligence feature testing to ensure appropriate handling of confidential and regulated information
* Monitor and report quality, performance, and artificial intelligence observability metrics including token consumption, streaming latency, tool-call success rates, model error rates, and reliability indicators
* Integrate automated testing into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, ensuring quality gates and deployment controls are effective and actionable
* Conduct test code reviews, mentor quality engineering team members, perform exploratory testing, and drive continuous improvement of testing practices and processes
* Support performance and load testing of cloud-native software-as-a-service platforms on Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure to validate scalability, availability, and reliability requirements
* Maintain clear test documentation, traceability matrices, defect analysis reports, and quality metrics to ensure transparency and alignment across stakeholders

**About The Team**
At Moody’s, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. As part of Moody’s Insurance Solutions, the Climate on Demand team develops innovative software, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence enabled capabilities that help organizations understand and manage climate and natural catastrophe risks. You will contribute to building impactful solutions that support informed decision-making, strengthen resilience for customers around the world, and advance the adoption of responsible artificial intelligence across our products and services.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

* Ability to work with and manage stakeholders across the globe.

* Ability to work and think independently; self-starter that demonstrates initiative and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously; demonstrates effective prioritization skills when balancing dynamic priorities.
* Inquisitive and data-oriented.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.

title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

* Design and calibrate automated judging, validating it against human review so that reported scores are meaningful and defensible.
* Own repeatable adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, guardrail bypass and data leakage, and rerun the suite after every material model or prompt change.
* Implement runtime safety controls, including content filtering, sensitive-data redaction, tool permissions, spend caps and circuit breakers.
* Instrument applications so quality, latency, tokens and model cost are observable per request, application and tenant.
* Own model-cost optimisation through routing, caching and prompt efficiency, using evaluation evidence to demonstrate when a lower-cost model is sufficient.
* Monitor production quality and drift, maintain a failure taxonomy, and feed observed failures back into benchmark datasets.
* Validate model upgrades before cutover so vendor model changes do not degrade client-facing systems.

* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.
* Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade-offs, and working with self-hosted or open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation.
* Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including the ability to work with non-technical subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and translate their judgement into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Hands-on OpenTelemetry instrumentation for nested, multi-step agents, including tool-call spans, session and conversation tracing, trace-context propagation across asynchronous workers and queues, and correlation IDs through background processing.
* Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases Weave; integration with platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana or Datadog; and structured telemetry for token usage, latency and cost by request, application and tenant.

Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Data Operations Associate
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience understanding complex data structures, schemas, and migration requirements, combined with proficiency in extract, transform, and load processes across enterprise environments.
* 3-7 years’ experience required for this role. Proficiency in SQL for data querying, manipulation, and validation, with experience mapping data fields between source and target systems to meet business rules and technical requirements.
* Knowledge of data validation techniques, data quality assurance best practices, and data governance principles, including documentation of business rules, standard operating procedures, and data lineage.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP or NetSuite, and hands-on experience with reporting and automation tools including Power Automate, Power BI, Alteryx, or Databricks; experience with master data management tools such as Collibra or DBeaver preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong problem-solving ability; capable of collaborating across business users, data stewards, and technical teams while clearly explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's / postgraduation degree in finance or Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field required

**Responsibilities**

* Supports enterprise-wide data migration initiatives by ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data as it transitions across systems.
* Analyzes data structures and identifies migration requirements, collecting, cleaning, and validating datasets from multiple source systems
* Documents business rules for data quality checks and applies validation and quality assurance techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency throughout the migration lifecycle
* Maps data fields from source to target systems and transforms data to align with new system requirements and business rules
* Executes data migration processes including extraction, transformation, and loading, monitoring migration progress and troubleshooting issues in real time
* Identifies and resolves data discrepancies, errors, and anomalies, collaborating with technical teams to implement corrective actions
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and visualizations to highlight key trends and document data quality issues for stakeholder review
* Works closely with business users, data stewards, and technical teams to gather requirements, communicate progress, and facilitate cross-functional alignment to ensure a smooth migration transition
* Creates and maintains comprehensive documentation including migration plans, data mappings, validation rules, standard operating procedures, and post-migration reports to support governance and audit readiness

**About The Team**
Our Ratings Operations and Controls (ROC) team is responsible for supporting the data management, quality, and operational processes that underpin Moody's global ratings and research activities. We contribute to Moody's by ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and consistency across critical systems, enabling seamless data transitions that support business continuity and analytical integrity, and driving operational efficiency through technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in enterprise data migration, digital transformation, and process innovation across our Gurgaon operations.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
  
  
For more information on the Securities Trading Program, please refer to the Securities Trading Policy on Moody’s Compliance Expo page

title: Quality Assurance Officer
description:
**Main Purpose**

**Responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of quality control operations within the laboratory unit. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that all laboratory activities, processes, and products meet the highest standards of quality, safety,and compliance with industry regulations. This role involves overseeing testing, inspection, auditing, and the implementation of corrective actions to ensure that quality benchmarks are consistently met.**

**Main Duties**

**Regulatory Affairs Ensure regulatory compliance India CDSCO / Pharmacopeia, FDA regulations / ISO 9000 and others as applicable**

**Quality Systems. Perform internal audits of Quality System according to Indian and US FDA's Quality System Requirements, ISO 9001 or any other quality standard deemed**

**necessary.**

* **Participate in external audits, including supplier audits, customer audits and inspections by Indian and FDA's agencies and ISO Notifying Body.**
* **Conducting periodical evaluation of Suppliers and supplier development. Prepare documents and data for different Supplier/ contractor for audits as needed**
* **Submit reports from internal and external audits to appropriate personnel and initiate audit follow up actions, to include Corrective and Preventive Actions where applicable.**
* **Provide support in development of QMS procedures, instructions and forms while ensuring continuous improvement of quality management system. Participate in implementing CAPA actions where needed**
* **Manage and maintain all aspects of the Quality System, including Change Control; CAPA; Customer Complaints and Compliance**
* **File complaints to vendors; initiate corrective action requests; assess suppliers' CAPA reports; participate in suppliers' auditing and qualification process.**

**Quality/Regulatory General**

* **Perform function of Official Correspondent in front of the FDA and other government authorities.**
* **Review and draft new business Quality Agreements.**
* **Supervise, coach, and develop all quality employees.**
* **Mentor, train, and recommend qualified employees for advancement.**
* **Perform the responsibilities of Quality Control Manager during his/her absence.**
* **Adhere to safety and security policies; participate in safety and security training and improvement projects**
* **Report unsafe or unhealthy conditions and assist with emergency or investigative situations related to areas of responsibility**

**Quality Assurance**

* **Maintain all controlled document files and test records in a timely and accurate manner.**
* **Maintain updated matrix of records; maintain backup copies of required records and archive.**
* **Participate in the qualification of packing processes and software validation as required.**
* **Coordinate associated training activities for the company: develop training matrix for every position and annual/semi-annual training plans, initiate training requests, perform trainings, and maintain training records**
* **Develop comprehensive Quality and Regulatory training programs for all employees.**
* **Make written procedures for identification, documentation, appropriate review and approval of RM, specifications, analytical methods, facilities, support systems, equipment, processing steps, labeling and packaging materials and computer software.**
* **Written procedures shall be established assigning responsibility for sanitation and describing the cleaning schedules, methods, equipment, and materials to be used in cleaning buildings and facilities**
* **Ensures written procedures for all activities carried out, are established and followed**
* **Ensures personnel shall practice good sanitation and health habits appropriate measures shall be established and implemented to prevent cross-contamination from personnel and materials moving from one dedicated area to another**
* **Ensures there are written procedures describing in detail the receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, testing and approval or rejection of raw material containers and closures and these procedures are followed**
* **Reviewing completed laboratory control records of critical process steps before release of the material.**
* **Reviewing and approving validation protocols and reports**
* **Ensuring data protection shall be established for all computerized systems**
* **Check records of different departments as needed for audits**
* **Validation of general, cleaning, analytical methods, in-process control, test procedures, computerized systems and persons responsible for design, review, approval and documentation of each validation phase**
* **Approving changes that potentially affect the product quality and performing below product quality reviews**
* **A review of all lot of raw materials that failed to meet established specification(s)**
* **A review of all critical deviations or non-conformances and related investigations**
* **A review of results of the stability monitoring program**
* **A review of all quality-related returns, complaints and recalls**
* **A review of adequacy of corrective actions**
* **Evaluate and assess the results of the above reviews and decide whether corrective or any revalidation shall be undertaken. Documents the reasons for such corrective action and ensures agreed corrective actions is completed in a timely and effective manner**
* **Ensures that training shall be regularly conducted by qualified individuals and shall cover, at a minimum, the particular operations that the employee performs and as applicable to the employee's functions.**
* **Ensures records of all the trainings are maintained and periodically assessed**
* **Investigate the discrepancies established during reconciliation of labels issued, used and returned**
* **Ensures raw material containers and closures shall at all times be handled and stored in a manner to prevent contamination**
* **Verifies each container or grouping of containers for raw material or each lot of raw material shall be appropriately identified as to its status(i.e., quarantined, approved, or rejected)**
* **Ensures each lot of raw material shall be withheld from use/export until the lot has been sampled, tested, or examined, as appropriate, and released for use/export by QC.**

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
