title: Email Quality Analyst (Night Shift)
description:
**What will you do?**

This role will focus on quality assurance for high-volume, customer-facing digital marketing communications, with particular emphasis on
**Email, Rich Content Messaging, and deep-linking experiences**
. The Senior QA Analyst will conduct detailed content, language, functional, and rendering validation to ensure campaigns are accurate, compliant, on-brand, and deliver a seamless experience across devices and digital touchpoints.

As a senior member of the QA team, this individual will also support and mentor other team members, contribute to QA process improvements, and help consolidate feedback and communications with internal stakeholders and client teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential to clearly articulate requirements, identify risks, and provide actionable feedback.

**Digital Content Quality Assurance**

* Perform end-to-end quality assurance reviews for digital outbound marketing communications, including: Email campaigns, Rich Content Messaging – RCS/ RBM, push, SMS/MMS, or other mobile messaging formats, where applicable
* Deep links to mobile applications, web pages, account experiences, product offers, and support journeys
* Conduct full rendering checks across relevant email clients, browsers, devices, operating systems, and screen sizes.
* Validate responsive design, layout, formatting, imagery, buttons, calls to action, personalization, and dynamic content.
* Review content for spelling, grammar, punctuation, language consistency, tone of voice, and adherence to approved copy.
* Ensure digital communications align with brand standards, campaign briefs, customer segmentation requirements, and approved legal or regulatory content.

**Functional Validation**

* Test all links, tracking parameters, CTA, and deep links to ensure they route customers to the intended destination.
* Validate campaign logic, offer details, personalization fields, audience targeting, eligibility messaging, and conditional content where applicable.
* Confirm that digital messages deliver a clear and consistent customer experience from message open through to the linked destination.
* Identify and document defects relating to content, rendering, functionality, user experience, or compliance.

**Team Collaboration and Client Communication**

* Act as a senior QA resource and subject matter expert for digital outbound content quality.
* Support, coach, and guide junior QA Analysts and other team members.
* Help maintain and improve QA checklists, test plans, standard operating procedures, and quality standards.
* Partner with project management and development teams to resolve issues efficiently.
* Assist in prioritizing QA activity across multiple campaigns, deadlines, and business requirements.
* Clearly articulate requirements, defects, risks, and recommendations in both written and verbal formats.
* Participate in client and stakeholder discussions as needed, helping ensure expectations, requirements, and approvals are understood.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately while maintaining a solutions-focused and collaborative approach.

**What will you need?**

* Proven experience in Quality Assurance, Content QA, Digital QA, Campaign QA, or a related role within a digital marketing, CRM, creative, or communications environment.
* Experience testing customer-facing outbound digital communications, particularly email and messaging campaigns.
* Strong knowledge of email rendering and responsive design principles across devices, browsers, and email clients.
* Experience validating URLs, CTAs, tracking links, and deep-linking journeys.
* Excellent written English with exceptional proofreading, grammar, and copy-review skills.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify inconsistencies in content, design, data, and functionality.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain requirements and provide actionable feedback.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders.
* Experience supporting, coaching, or mentoring team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms, email service providers, and content management systems.
* Understanding of personalization, segmentation, dynamic content, campaign workflows, and customer journey orchestration.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards and best practices for digital communications, including email accessibility.

**Key Attributes**

* Highly detail-oriented, organized, and quality-focused.
* Strong communicator who can articulate requirements, risks, and recommendations with clarity.
* Proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership.
* Collaborative leader who supports the development of others.
* Customer-focused, with an understanding of the importance of accurate and seamless digital experiences.
* Able to balance precision with pace in a high-volume marketing environment.

description:
Internal Job Posting
  
  
Last date to apply : 28th Oct
  
  
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
* Minimum 12 months experience as D1/D2
* Should have at least “On-Track” or equivalent rating in last appraisal.
* Should not be under any Performance Counselling Plan or had any official disciplinary action within the last 3 months.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

description:

Data Strategy Group

**Overview**
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
  
  
**Scope**
We are seeking a highly accomplished
**Principal Engineer**
to serve as the technical authority and architectural leader for our cloud-native platform and infrastructure within the Financial Platform organization. In this role, you will define the platform architecture roadmap, design mission-critical infrastructure patterns, and lead the technical execution of platforms that power large-scale, distributed financial applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform Architecture & Strategic Direction: Define and drive the target-state architecture for our next-generation, cloud-native platform (Kubernetes, multi-region cloud topologies, and AI/workload enablement). Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities.
* Modern Web & End-to-End Automation with Playwright: Standardize and implement Playwright for modern browser and web application automation, utilizing browser context isolation, parallel test execution, request interception, and resilient auto-waiting mechanisms for frontend platform portals.
* Automated Regression, Integrated & Functional Testing: Architect and drive automated testing frameworks across the platform lifecycle, establishing continuous automated regression suites across CI/CD environments, multi-service integrated testing across distributed microservices and event brokers, and end-to-end functional automated tests validating complex financial workflows and edge cases.
* Hands-On Core Engineering: Lead by example by writing production-grade code, building foundational custom tooling/operators (Typescript, Python), authoring reusable Terraform modules, and designing reference implementations for engineering teams.
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and technical coach to junior and mid-level engineers. Facilitate design reviews, establish architecture RFC processes, conduct deep code/infrastructure reviews, and foster a strong culture of engineering excellence.
* Enterprise CI/CD & Developer Experience (DevEx): Architect automated, self-service golden paths and progressive delivery pipelines (canary, blue-green) that minimize cognitive load for application developers while ensuring strict deployment guardrails.
* Observability, SRE & Chaos Engineering: Design holistic telemetry strategies utilizing OpenTelemetry. Define enterprise SLI/SLO standards, error budget policies, resilience testing/chaos engineering, and lead complex root-cause analyses (RCA) for critical production incidents.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, QA Automation, SRE, Distributed Systems, or Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale, production-grade distributed systems.
* Architecture & System Design: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud topologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Automated Test Engineering Mastery: Demonstrated proficiency in architecting automated regression, integration, and functional test frameworks; extensive hands-on experience with Playwright for web/UI testing and modern API testing tools.
* Security, Auth & Impersonation Validation: Hands-on experience testing and validating authentication/authorization modules (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), RBAC access matrices, and user impersonation security logic.
* Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Mid-level proficiency with Terraform(custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno).
* Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority.
* Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana ecosystems, and enterprise SRE practices.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting platforms within highly regulated domains (e.g., Financial Services, FinTech, Banking).

title: Analyst – CLM Configuration
description:
**About Sirion**
Sirion is the world’s leading AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform, transforming the way global enterprises manage their contracting journey. Powered by generative AI, Sirion delivers intelligent extraction, conversational search, and AI-driven negotiation capabilities for some of the world’s most valuable brands. With over 7M+ contracts worth nearly $800B under management and recognition from Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters, Sirion continues to set the benchmark for innovation in CLM.
  
  
www.sirion.ai
  
  
**Power the Future of SaaS Delivery & Why This Role Matters**
As an Analyst – CLM Configuration, you will play a key role in configuring and automating legal contract templates within Sirion’s Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. You will transform approved legal documents and clause libraries into dynamic, reusable templates that enable clients to generate accurate contracts based on predefined business rules and requirements.
  
  
Working closely with clients, legal teams, business stakeholders and internal implementation teams, you will configure template logic, validate contract outputs and ensure high-quality delivery within agreed timelines. This role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking and an understanding of contract structures, with a focus on accuracy, automation and client satisfaction.
  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact**
**Contract Template Configuration & Automation**

* Configure approved legal contract templates and clause libraries, including NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, DPAs, purchase agreements and service agreements, within Sirion’s CLM platform.
* Map contract fields, variables and data points to enable automated contract generation.
* Configure clause assembly, conditional logic and fallback clauses based on predefined business rules, contract requirements and approved legal language.
* Support template configuration across different languages, governing laws and jurisdictions, ensuring the appropriate clauses and provisions are applied.

**Template Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate template configurations and ensure contracts are generated accurately across different scenarios and combinations of business rules.
* Identify, troubleshoot and resolve configuration issues, inconsistencies and defects in contract outputs.
* Validate template functionality against approved requirements and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve issues before production deployment.
* Maintain quality standards and ensure templates are ready for production within agreed timelines.

**Client Engagement & Delivery Management**

* Participate in client kick-off meetings, template discussions and requirement-gathering sessions to understand business and legal requirements.
* Collaborate with client legal teams, business stakeholders and internal implementation teams to clarify requirements, validate approved clauses and translate business needs into configuration rules.
* Estimate effort and manage assigned templates independently, ensuring timely delivery against agreed project milestones.
* Manage multiple templates and concurrent client engagements, prioritising work effectively while maintaining accuracy and quality.

**Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table**
**Experience & Education**

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in CLM implementation, contract template configuration, document automation or legal technology.
* Hands-on experience configuring contract templates, clause libraries, conditional rules or automated document-generation solutions.
* Experience working with CLM platforms such as Sirion, Icertis, Conga or other comparable contract management solutions is preferred.
* Familiarity with legal contract structures and documents such as NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, DPAs and purchase or service agreements.
* A legal or paralegal background is an advantage.

**Functional & Technical Skills**

* Understanding of contract structures, clause libraries, contract variables and document-generation logic.
* Ability to translate business and legal requirements into configurable template rules.
* Experience with UAT, test scenarios, defect identification, troubleshooting and quality assurance.
* Familiarity with different governing laws, jurisdictions and language-specific contract requirements is an advantage.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and quality.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret requirements and troubleshoot configuration issues.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with clients and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple templates and meet delivery commitments.
* A client-focused mindset and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the wider team.

title: Associate Manager - Drone Ecosystem
description:
**About QCI**

The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030.

**Role Summary**

As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential.

The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone-as-a-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation’s Drone Ecosystem.

**Role & Responsibility-**

QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below:

* **Scheme Design & Development**
  : Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS.
* **Research, Analysis & Knowledge Products**
  : Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components.
* **Report Writing & Deck Preparation:**
  Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders.
* **Scheme Operations**
  : Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**
  : Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i.e., regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination.
* **Business Development & Marketing of the Scheme**
  : Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation.

**Eligibility Criteria & Requirements-**

**Educational Qualification**
:

* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role.
* An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage.

**Experience-**

* Minimum 3 years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program.
* Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required.
* Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred.
* Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory.
* Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired.
* Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required.

**Technical Capabilities-**

**Strong Research Skills:**
Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e.g., government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information.

**Structured Thinking & Writing:**
Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well-written outputs.

**Data Analysis:**
Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage.

**Visualization & Presentation Skills:**
Strong data-visualization skills using MS Office Suite, with Tableau/Power BI proficiency being an added advantage; ability to create well-structured and visually compelling presentations.

**Behavioural Capabilities-**

**High Degree of Curiosity:**
Genuine interest in how India’s public policy and governance systems work; naturally follows current affairs and asks “why.”

**Integrity & Accountability:**
Takes ownership of tasks, delivers on commitments, and upholds the highest ethical standards in all work and workplace interactions.

**Meticulous Attention to Detail:**
Able to identify typos, formatting errors, inconsistencies, and mismatched numbers that others may overlook.

**Proactive & “Get-it-Done” Attitude:**
Self-starter who takes complete ownership of tasks, anticipates what needs to be done, and delivers results without waiting for instructions.

description:
**Job Title:**
Assistant Quality Assurance (QA) Manager

**Department:**
Quality Assurance & Food Safety

**Reports To:**
QA Manager / Head of Quality

**Location:**
On-site (Factory Operations) Delhi

**Job Purpose**

Oversee daily factory food safety, regulatory compliance, and quality operations. Drive full implementation of
**FSSC 22000 (v6)**
, manage incoming Raw Material (RM/PM) testing, ensure statutory compliance, and lead specialized
**QC testing matrices for beverage and frozen product lines**
.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Regulatory & Legal Compliance:**
  Ensure factory-wide adherence to national/international food laws, additive limits, and labeling rules. Manage factory licenses, product registrations, packaging artwork approvals, and serve as the liaison during government inspections.

* **FSSC 22000 v6 & Systems Management:**
  Implement and maintain FSSC 22000 v6, HACCP, PRPs, and OPRPs. Lead internal/external audits, non-conformance management, RCA, and CAPA execution.

* **Beverage QC Matrix Operations:**
  Oversee line testing for syrup, batching, thermal processing (Pasteurization/UHT), and filling. Monitor physicochemical parameters (Brix, pH, acidity, $CO\_2$ volumes, viscosity), microbiological stability (yeast, mold, TAB), and Water Treatment Plant (WTP) quality parameters.

* **Frozen Products QC Matrix Operations:**
  Enforce cold chain monitoring across receiving, IQF/blast freezing, storage ($-18^\circ\text{C}$), and dispatch. Oversee testing for drip loss %, thaw stability, glazed %, and high-risk pathogens (
  *Listeria*
  ,
  *Salmonella*
  , psychrotrophs).

* **Factory Operations & Floor Quality:**
  Enforce strict hygiene, sanitation, GMP/GHP, and environmental monitoring programs (EMP). Conduct daily process audits, train production staff, and drive 5S/yield improvement projects.

* **RM & PM Quality Control:**
  Oversee receiving, sampling, and Certificate of Analysis (CoA) verifications for incoming ingredients/materials. Manage supplier rejections, vendor CAPAs, allergen control, and traceability systems.

**Key Qualifications & Skills:**

* **Education & Experience:**
  Bachelor’s/Master’s in Food Technology, Food Science, Chemistry, or Microbiology. 5–8 years of food plant QA/QC experience (2+ years in a supervisory role), preferably spanning both beverage and frozen food lines.

* **Certifications:**
  HACCP Certified.
  **Certified Internal Auditor for FSSC 22000 v6 / ISO 22000 is strongly preferred.**

* **Core Competencies:**

* Proven track record as an
  **Internal Auditor**
  , with hands-on experience planning, conducting, and reporting on internal FSSC 22000/HACCP audits.

* Strong expertise in food regulatory laws, packaging compliance, and statutory standards.

* Hands-on knowledge of beverage parameters ($CO\_2$, Brix, pH, WTP) and frozen matrix testing (IQF, drip loss, cold chain, psychrotrophs).

* Direct experience in FSSC v6 mandates (Food Defense, Food Fraud, Equipment/Waste Management) and factory CIP/COP systems.

title: Engineer - Receiving Quality
description:
**Job title: Receiving Quality Engineer**
**Location:**
Ghaziabad
  
  
**About Us**
Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.
  
  
**Job Overview**
This position will be responsible for Bought out parts Quality Assurance to ensure high quality product & on time delivery for Power Tools and Lifting products manufactured in Sahibabad plant. This person will also support for the customised project parts qualification for quality aspect. This involves understanding the part & product requirements, preparing Quality assurance plan, resolving technical challenges, lead Quality issues resolution. This person must be a team player, form strong ties with a cross functional team, manage a multitude of tasks, communicate clearly, and be effective and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* To ensure that incoming materials and products meet required quality standards.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, tests, and quality issues.
* Interacts frequently with internal and external contacts (such as Procurement, Solutions Engineering, Operations and suppliers) to ensure the completion of strategic AQP activities.
* Completes Qualification of materials and components (Project Procurement), development/ improvement of supplier parts for CTQ's, Incoming process control plans; ensuring that the supplied part meets specifications, and the control limits/tolerances for CTQ parameters are met.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret data related to quality, using statistical tools and methods.
* Responsible to address field Issue received due to supplier parts & Perform Root Cause analysis & ensure corrective actions on time.
* Collaborate with suppliers and internal operations team for product build and validation.
* Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by identifying and implementing process enhancements.
* Improve Assembly & Machine shop DSA
* Improve Assembly FPY
* Reduction in COPQ due to Supplier Parts
* Receipt Material clearance in 1 Day

**Requirements**

* Relevant degree, B.Tech./BE or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a reputed university.
* 10+ years’ experience in Engineering/Automotive Industry.

**Core Competencies**

* Proficient in Engineering Drawing reading & GD&T.
* In-depth Knowledge of the manufacturing processes (machining, plastic, casting, sheet metal).
* Strong understanding of quality control principles, inspection methods, and statistical analysis.
* Handling knowledge of CMM, Contour Tracer, Roughness Tester, Hardness Tester & 2D height Gauge.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage time and complete simultaneous multiple assignments.
* Proven ability to interact with suppliers and convince on Quality aspects.

**Preferences**

* Relevant degree, B.Tech./BE/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

**Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements**

* Travel (As and When required)

**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

title: Process Engineer II
description:
**Description**
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. If you would like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history and be involved in growing our business by leading and supporting new building expansion and change.
  
  
Tech – Supply Chain manages all IT infrastructure and end-user equipment deployed across Amazon's network globally. The team is responsible for providing end-to-end solutions that include lifecycle management, change control, capital/demand planning, material management, Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA), and liquidation.
  
  
The Process Engineering team converts network strategies and operational standards into executable engineering solutions that power device fulfillment, value-added services, and reverse logistics across the RAD network. By optimizing layouts, engineering scalable workstations, and validating system interactions between tools, labour, and infrastructure, the team ensures RAD can expand fulfillment capacity while maintaining safety, operational efficiency, and service reliability.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze and evaluate existing fulfillment workflows across device fulfillment, value-added services, and reverse logistics, identifying opportunities for optimization and cost-per-unit reduction.
* Utilize lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodologies, value stream mapping, and simulation-based capacity analysis to drive operational excellence and reduce costs.
* Conduct time-motion studies, workflow analysis, line balancing, productivity modeling, and process mapping to identify throughput constraints and inefficiencies.
* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and engineering standards to ensure consistent and efficient operations.
* Support the engineering execution of RAD expansion and new facility launches, including feasibility studies, labour and capacity models, workflow design, and ergonomic validation.
* Contribute to site design and material flow strategies that enable RAD to grow with predictable throughout and controlled operational risk.
* Support ERP/WMS implementation efforts and help validate system and process designs, including system interactions between tools, labour, and infrastructure.
* Integrate quality engineering principles directly into workflow design, using tools such as FMEA, control plans, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) analysis to strengthen process reliability.
* Conduct process and product quality audits to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement opportunities.
* Drive proactive risk identification, root cause analysis, and implementation of engineering controls to prevent recurrence of systemic failure points.
* Support the establishment and maturation of a Quality Management System (QMS) to improve quality outcomes and meet customer needs.

A day in the life
  
  
We are looking for a Process Engineer based in India who can collaborate across multiple functional and operational teams to establish and improve our engineering processes. This role will design factory layouts, scalable workstations, and material flow systems; diagnose process constraints; identify improvement opportunities; prescribe engineering solutions; and guide improvement efforts from concept through execution.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
* Bachelor's degree in industrial or manufacturing engineering
* Knowledge of automated material handling systems, packaging technologies and storage solutions

title: 1985306-Lead Assistant Manager
description: Job Description – Quality Analyst Purpose: The Quality Management Team (QMT) is responsible for the development (governance), implementation (execution), and management of the quality management system (QMS) and promoting a quality culture throughout the organization. The QMT oversees the responsibilities of quality monitoring, thus improving the customer experience, reducing the total cost of defects and errors, establishing quality in our products and processes, and continually seeking to improve the effectiveness of the company’s QMS. Roles & Responsibilities: Evaluates operations from a strategic level, monitoring that products and services meet quality standards. Collaborates with management and senior staff across departments and roles to establish organizational and departmental quality standards. Develops and teaches quality procedures, processes, programs, and best practices that support continuous improvement of the QMS. Ensures strong lines of communication and working relationships are always maintained across the organization, developing trust and accountability. Conducts industry benchmarking analyses specific to quality, and recommends improvement initiatives. Periodically reports on the status of quality processes and outcomes of Root Cause Analysis to executive leadership and, when required, regulatory agencies. Analyzes existing business processes to identify impediments to quality, flow, and failure modes, collaborating to remove rework and complexity that hinder efficient and effective processes and a lack of quality. Liaises with senior leaders, business process owners, business partners, and associates, to share findings, identify business improvement activities, and develop holistic solutions that solve business problems and address root-cause findings, in the most efficient and effective way, while maintaining adequate quality. Oversees the PQG Training Program, including responsibility for developing the organization’s quality learning and development strategy. Manages the PQG Community of Practice, updating members on key priorities, messaging, and training to be shared and disseminated throughout the organization, and managing quality projects in progress. Leads and participates in proactive continuous improvement and quality focused activities. Drives continuous employee awareness and feedback on quality initiatives, as well as an effective communication and training strategy that includes developing a quality specific reward and recognition program. Supports business units in identifying key quality metrics that should be measured and monitored. Manages and leads the root-cause-analysis framework and resolution processes, to include the designing, documenting, and maintaining organizational standards, processes, and procedures specific to quality and the root-cause resolution frameworks used throughout the organization. Agrees (through governance and collaboration) on the prioritization of issues for further evaluation using industry prioritization and evaluation techniques. Tracks and maintains a database of quality issues, root-cause analyses, recommendations, and business improvement plans to ensure the desired outcomes have been met. Performs other related duties as assigned. Required Technical Skills: Understanding of and experience in implementing Shingo or similar quality frameworks. Belting certifications in Lean and/or Six Sigma must be obtained within 12 months of joining the team. Action oriented, being able to see and think outside the box and challenge the status quo. Excellent root cause analysis skills – including but not limited to knowledge and experience of RCA techniques and methodologies (6 Sigma, Lean), and help the appropriate divisional personnel to do the same. A pro-active and analytical approach to problem solving. Strong interpersonal and communication skills (both verbal and written). Good negotiating and influencing skills at all levels. Strong project management skills. The ability to facilitate change. Quality Analyst Supports the execution of American Modern’s quality and root cause frameworks by having proficient knowledge of AMIG products, systems, and processes obtained through training and hands-on experience. Successfully executes the daily operational functions related to quality and root cause analyses. Ability to apply knowledge and skills to improve operational and quality excellence through collaboration and communication, while recognizing when and where process improvements are needed and quality deficiencies exist through quality assurance and root cause analysis. Demonstrates the ability to perform straight-forward root cause analysis, analyze issues, and develop procedural changes to effectively address them. A proven record of accomplishments in addressing complicated and sometimes inconsistent information to effectively solve problems. Assists in the execution of the Quality Training Program, the Community of Practice, and key communication initiatives specific to quality. title: Quality Assurance Executive - Garment Manufacturing
description:
We’re Hiring | Quality Assurance Executive – Garment Export

PREWAL is looking for a hands-on QA professional to work closely with our Technical Head and strengthen quality across cutting, embroidery, stitching, finishing, and packing.

Location: Gurgaon

Employment: Full-time, on-site

Reporting to: Technical Head

The Role

You will help implement quality standards on the production floor, identify problems early, and verify that corrective actions are completed. This is an active floor-based role, not a desk-only reporting position or solely a final-checking role.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct first-piece, inline, end-line, and finishing checks against approved samples, measurements, and style requirements.

• Help prepare and implement style-specific checklists and visual quality references under the Technical Head’s guidance.

• Check embroidery placement, workmanship, beading, garment construction, measurements, and finishing.

• Communicate defects and required corrections clearly to the relevant department in-charge.

• Track corrective actions, recheck corrected work, and maintain evidence of closure.

• Support checker training and assess whether checking standards are being followed consistently.

• Maintain accurate inspection reports, defect records, and daily quality updates using Excel.

• Identify recurring defects and support practical preventive action to reduce avoidable repairs and rework.

• Escalate serious quality risks promptly through the agreed hold and release process.

Candidate Profile

• Preferably a diploma or degree in Garment Technology, Apparel Production, Textile Technology, or a related discipline.

• Approximately 3–5 years of relevant garment QA/QC experience, with strong production-floor exposure.

• Sound knowledge of garment construction, measurements, workmanship, and inspection methods.

• Experience with embroidery, embellishment, or detailed garments is preferred.

• Able to read specifications, measurement charts, and buyer comments, and prepare clear written reports.

• Comfortable using Excel and communicating professionally with production teams.

• Able to follow problems through to verified correction, rather than only reporting defects.

To Apply

Please send your CV through LinkedIn direct message, including your current location, relevant experience, current and expected compensation, and notice period.

title: Product Engineer (App and Platforms)
description: Job DescriptionThis is a delivery-focused role rather than a purely supervisory one: you will carry out the majority of the day-to-day design, development, and implementation work directly. You will be Ansh's primary technical owner of our app and website, working closely with our Analytics Engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from the app into our dashboards, with the M& E and program teams to understand their requirements, and with the C-suite to ensure our technology and roadmap keep pace with our growth. Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g., Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2.4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e., electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. We help our clients implement and effectively use Oracle offerings to solve their business problems and fuel success in the areas of finance operations, human capital management, supply chain management, reporting and analytics, and governance, risk and compliance.
  
  
  

Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module Consultant
  
  

Discrete Manufacturing, OPM Manufacturing, ASCP Discreet , ASCP OPM , MRP , Discreet Quality , Process Quality , Discreet Costing , Process Costing & SLA
  
  

Job Description:
  
  

As an Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module Consultant, your primary responsibility will be to provide expertise and support in implementing, configuring, and optimizing the Oracle Supply Chain Management (SCM) Manufacturing Module for clients. You will work closely with clients, project teams, and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective system solutions.
  
  

Key Responsibilities:
  
  

1. Implementation and Configuration: Lead or participate in the implementation and configuration of Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module, including setting up manufacturing organizations, defining manufacturing parameters, creating bill of materials (BOM), routings, work definitions, and production schedules.
  
  

2. Business Process Analysis: Collaborate with clients to analyze their existing manufacturing processes, identify gaps, and recommend process improvements leveraging Oracle SCM Manufacturing capabilities.
  
  

3. System Customization: Customize Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module to meet specific business requirements, such as creating custom reports, user interfaces, and workflows.
  
  

4. Integration: Collaborate with technical teams to integrate Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module with other enterprise systems, such as ERP, PLM, and MES, ensuring seamless data flow and process synchronization.
  
  

5. Testing and Validation: Develop test plans, conduct system testing, and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the implemented Oracle SCM Manufacturing solution.
  
  

6. User Training and Support: Provide end-user training on Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module functionality, conduct workshops, and create user documentation. Additionally, offer ongoing support and troubleshooting for users, addressing system issues and providing guidance.
  
  

7. Change Management: Support change management activities by assisting clients in adapting to the new system, communicating system changes, and facilitating user adoption.
  
  

8. Best Practices and Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest Oracle SCM Manufacturing trends, best practices, and industry standards. Identify
  
  

Qualifications and Skills:
  
  

- Bachelor's or Master's
  
  

- Proven experience (6 years) working with Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module, including implementation, configuration, and support.
  
  

- Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, such as discrete manufacturing, process manufacturing, and lean manufacturing.
  
  

- Proficiency in Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module functionalities, including BOM, routings, work definitions, production scheduling, shop floor control, and quality management.
  
  

- Knowledge of integration between Oracle SCM Manufacturing Module
  
  

- Familiarity with Oracle Cloud SCM is preferred.
  
  

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills to identify and resolve issues effectively.
  
  

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with clients and project teams.
  
  

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently or as part of a team

**\*\*\*Please read the requirements before applying\*\*\***

* **PRIOR EXPERIENCE WORKING AT AN MBO IS A MUST**
* **ABILITY TO COME TO THE OFFICE IN DELHI FIVE TIMES A WEEK IS A MUST**
* **SHOULD BE ABLE TO JOIN IMMEDIATELY**

**Company Description**

Mrs. G is a multi-designer e-commerce platform for Indian occasion and bridal wear, connecting the global diaspora with 100+ curated designers from India. Built on a made-to-order model with direct-from-India fulfillment, Mrs. G offers custom fit, rigorous quality checks, concierge bridal styling, and worldwide shipping across key markets including the US, UK, UAE, Canada, and Australia. Founded by Sana Chopra, the company is headquartered in Miami, USA and has a back office in Delhi, India

**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-obsessed Quality Assurance Specialist to own the quality assurance process, including designer coordination, production follow-ups, quality checks, packaging, logistics, and export documentation. You'll work closely with designers, shipping partners, and our internal team to make sure every order meets our standards and reaches the customer accurately and on time. It's a hands-on role with real ownership across functions.

title: Senior AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Engineering Expert
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking experienced AI Evaluation Engineers specializing in engineering simulation and design to author and validate complex, simulation-based engineering problems for training and evaluating state-of-the-art AI agents. The role spans electrical, mechanical, control systems, aerospace, systems, and robotics engineering. You will create challenging, multi-constraint tasks that require agents to interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will analyze agent execution logs, identify reasoning and tool-use gaps, and build objective automated graders.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Author self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders.
  
Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches.
  
Analyze agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes, such as misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature convergence, or physically impossible geometries.
  
Refine benchmark difficulty based on model performance data while avoiding ambiguity or missing information.
  
Collaborate with AI researchers, pod leads, and domain experts to integrate rigorous benchmarks into model-evaluation pipelines.
  
Requirements
  
A master's degree or PhD in electrical, mechanical, or aerospace engineering, and 10+ years of hands-on engineering design experience. The description also lists a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in any field as an education pathway.
  
Proficiency in at least one relevant open-source simulation package, such as ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, or Gmsh, along with strong Python scripting skills.
  
Hands-on experience with modern LLMs or coding agents and evaluation concepts such as pass@k, failure-mode analysis, and nondeterministic behavior; ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate reasoning or tool-use failures.
  
Strong attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation.
  
A stable, high-speed internet connection and a personal computer suitable for remote work.
  
Availability for 40 hours per week, four hours of overlap with PST, and weekend on-call availability. Part-time engagement is also noted as acceptable.

description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

**About the Role**

Here at Anaplan, we have reinvented how companies see, plan, and run their businesses. Our platform allows our customers to uncover new insights, connect their strategy to their plans, and work in ways they had not previously thought possible. Anaplan is the only scenario planning and analysis platform designed to optimize decision-making in today's complex business environment so that enterprises can outpace their competition and the market. By building connections and collaboration across organizational silos, our platform intelligently surfaces key insights — so businesses can make the right decisions, right now. We are seeking a talented AI QA Lead to guide our team and ensure the quality and reliability of our cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing QA Engineers across multiple stream aligned teams.
* Define and drive the overall QA strategy for our Forecasting project, with a focus on time-series forecasting.
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automated test frameworks.
* Guide the team in implementing and executing robust test cases for our AI-powered features and APIs.
* Champion the use of BDD frameworks, such as Gherkin, to create clear, concise, and maintainable tests.
* Ensure the team effectively tests and validates RESTful APIs to meet high standards of quality and performance.
* Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and engineering leads to align on quality standards and release criteria.
* Oversee the identification, documentation, and tracking of bugs and inconsistencies in our AI/ML systems.
* Drive improvements to our CI/CD pipeline to ensure that our AI models are continuously tested and deployed with confidence.

**Required Qualifications**

* A skilled QA Engineer with 8+ years of experience testing and assuring the quality of complex platform, infrastructure, or data-centric systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring a QA team in a fast-paced technical environment.
* Deep understanding of machine learning concepts and a proven track record of testing ML models, particularly in the domain of time-series forecasting.
* Expertise with testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Strong experience with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Gherkin.
* In-depth knowledge of API testing and validation.
* Proficiency in modern software development practices (testing, code review, CI/CD).
* A proven track record of delivering complex technical projects on time with high quality.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with performance, scalability, and security testing of AI systems.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and their AI/ML services.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
* Experience with strategic planning and roadmap development for a QA function.
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* You will lead a talented team at the forefront of AI innovation, working on a platform that is transforming how businesses make decisions.
* You will have a strategic impact, shaping the future of quality for our AI-powered products.
* You will be part of a collaborative and creative leadership team that values openness, authenticity, and inclusivity.
* We are a fast-growing company, and you will have ample opportunities for professional growth and to define your team's trajectory.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

capSpire is a fast-growing consulting and solutions company with a global footprint with eight offices in the world’s leading markets. We pride ourselves in being truly entrepreneurial, innovative, and collaborative, with a strong problem-solving ethos. We have built working relationships which span decades with many of the world’s largest energy and commodity companies. We believe that this is because we put our people first and are passionate about providing our clients with deep technical and industry insights that deliver pragmatic solutions. As we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This rich diversity fuels our business and enriches our culture

 

**About the role**

 

We are currently growing our ETRM/CTRM Endur practice and are looking for experienced Endur Consultants with expertise in Commodity or Energy markets and Trading and Risk Management System Implementations. You will be part of the team involved in implementation/upgrade/support of Endur, bringing SME knowledge in deal modelling, deal valuations, risk management, scheduling, invoicing, and accounting for commodities and energy. You will ensure successful project delivery, employing consultancy and best practices. 

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Collaborate with clients and prospects to determine business requirements and processes to be addressed by key areas of the Endur solution, with the ability to identify improvement potential and drive change management.
* Work as part of a team on the functional implementation, encompassing design, configuration, functional testing and support transition to operations of Endur solution.
* Support existing solutions for bug fixes, enhancements and operations.
* Document business requirements, implementation designs, test plans/results, and other deliverables required by the project.
* Follow best practices, documentation standards, and resolution process flow for all deliverables.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create customisations based on specific client needs
* Provide industry and functional advisory as needed.
* Apply appropriate resourcing techniques given project-specific needs, risks, and differences in core project team member skill levels and relevant modules to be delivered in client projects.
* Maintain highly effective communication with client and internal stakeholders and adept in handling business changes and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Provide guidance and training on Endur functionality and general ETRM/CTRM topics.

**Skills**

 

* Endur Modules: Good working knowledge in key modules of Endur and commodity/energy operations with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* Endur Risk Management: Knowledge of Endur risk and valuation functionality including results (MTM, PnL, VAR), and EOD automation (TPM and Services Manager).
* Endur Customisation: Deep knowledge of standard and customisation approaches for implementation of requirements, support for reporting, building complex desktops, APM pages, and pre/post-processing logic.
* Endur Architecture: Understanding of Endur architecture and best implementation practices to optimize its strengths for the client solution.
* Functional Knowledge: Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi-tasking and Project Management skills.
* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

 

**Required Experience**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience in a related field
* 4+ years hands-on with Endur as a consultant, business analyst, functional specialist, QA specialist or IT support specialist with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 4+ years of industry work experience.
* Good working understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.
* Experience in conducting comprehensive testing and quality assurance activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of Endur solutions.
* Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary.
* Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel to onsite client locations for limited time as per project requirement.

**Preferred Experience**

 

* Subject matter expert or functional consultant in Commodity Trading, Risk or Logistics business areas in large enterprise environments.
* Worked in Front, Middle or Back Office functions with specialty in any of the following: Trading (Derivatives, Physical), Risk (Market, Credit, Operational, Compliance), Logistics (Pipeline, Vessel, Nomination) or Settlements (AR/AP Process, Invoice Management).
* Experience with Endur gMotion or cMotion modules would be advantageous.

**What to expect as a capSpire consultant**

 

As part of a capSpire team, you’ll experience the full project life-cycle and be part of a dynamic team in which diversity, camaraderie and professional excellence are celebrated. We like to have fun as a team, encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning and take pride in delivering the best possible outcomes for our clients. 

 

If you think you have the necessary skills and experience to excel as a capSpire Consultant we are keen to speak with you.

title: Laboratory & Quality Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
LOHIA ALLOYS PRIVATE LIMITED is a mining and metals company based in Delhi, India, specializing in the manufacture of stainless steel coils and pipes in various grades. The company focuses on delivering high-quality stainless steel products to diverse industrial sectors. With an emphasis on reliability and performance, We leverage modern manufacturing practices and quality standards. Prospective team members can expect to work with a company committed to precision, consistency, and continuous improvement in its product line.

***About the Role***

We are looking for a
**Laboratory & Quality Specialist**
to take ownership of our in-house material testing and laboratory operations for stainless steel pipes and coils.

We already have a range of testing equipment at our manufacturing facility, and this role will be responsible for putting that equipment to effective use, standardizing our testing processes, maintaining proper records, and developing professional
**Material Test Certificates (MTCs)**
for our finished products of all grades.

The role will work closely with our production and quality teams to understand material properties, identify quality issues, and use testing data to improve product consistency and manufacturing processes.

***Key Responsibilities***

* Conduct routine and specialized testing of stainless steel pipes, coils and finished products.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment including:
* **Universal Testing Machine (UTM)**
* **Vickers & Rockwell Hardness Testers**
* **Metallurgical/Microscopic Examination Equipment**
* **Muffle Furnace**
* Prepare samples and carry out testing in accordance with relevant specifications and testing standards.
* Record, analyze and maintain accurate test results and laboratory documentation.
* Develop standardized
  **testing procedures, sampling methods and laboratory SOPs**
  .
* Prepare professional
  **Material Test Certificates (MTCs)**
  based on test results.
* Maintain traceability between raw material, production batches, samples and finished products.
* Analyze test results to identify variations, trends or quality issues.
* Work with production and quality teams to investigate material and process-related problems.
* Support product development, process improvement and customer-specific testing requirements.
* Help establish and continuously improve the company's overall
  **in-house laboratory and quality-control system**
  .

***What We're Looking For***

* Diploma or degree in
  **Metallurgy, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry or a related field**
  .
* Practical experience in
  **material testing, metallurgy, quality control or metal manufacturing**
  .
* Hands-on experience with UTM, hardness testing, microscopy/metallography or similar laboratory equipment.
* Understanding of
  **stainless steel, mechanical properties and material testing standards**
  .
* Strong analytical and documentation skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to interpret test results and communicate findings clearly.
* Knowledge of
  **ASTM, ASME, EN, ISO or other relevant testing standards**
  will be an advantage.
* Someone who is comfortable working independently and can
  **build and standardize processes from the ground up**
  .

***Why this role matters?***

**Sample Collection → Testing → Result Analysis → Documentation → Test Certificate → Traceability → Quality Improvement**

This is an opportunity to build and take ownership of an important part of our manufacturing and quality infrastructure. The objective is to develop a reliable in-house testing system that allows us to
**validate our products, improve consistency, provide customers with professional test documentation, and strengthen our overall quality standards.**

**Location: Sonipat, Haryana**
