Full-time

title: EHS and Quality Systems Executive
description:
**About the Organisation**
: Karo Sambhav is a leading sustainability and circular economy organization focused on enabling responsible waste management and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance across India. The company works with producers, recyclers, government bodies, and consumers to build transparent, technology-driven systems for the collection, recycling, and recovery of electronic waste, plastic waste, batteries, and other regulated materials. With a strong focus on environmental impact, compliance, and scalable sustainability solutions, Karo Sambhav helps organizations meet regulatory obligations while driving long-term circular economy initiatives.

**About the Role**
: The Quality Systems & EHS Executive will lead the Quality Management System (QMS) and certification programs for a high‑volume recycling/ITAD facility in North India. This role ensures compliance with
**ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3, e‑Stewards, EPR requirements,**
and customer‑specific quality protocols, while driving continuous improvement across operations.

The position requires strong experience in quality systems, audits, documentation, and regulatory compliance, with the ability to work in fast‑paced recycling environments involving e‑waste, metals, plastics, and IT asset disposition.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Quality Systems & Certification Leadership**

* Build, implement, and maintain a robust QMS aligned with ISO 9001 and recycling‑sector standards.
* Lead certification and surveillance audits for
  **ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3,**
  e‑Stewards, and brand‑mandated audits.
* Own document control: SOPs, WI, formats, change management, training records, and version control.
* Conduct internal audits, supplier audits, and process audits; maintain audit calendars and closure reports.
* Drive CAPA, RCA, FMEA, and PDCA across all departments.
* Ensure material traceability, chain‑of‑custody, downstream vendor compliance, and data integrity for recycling and ITAD workflows.
* Prepare and maintain customer‑facing quality documentation, including compliance reports, certificates, and audit evidence.
* Lead customer audits, brand audits, and OEM compliance reviews.

**2. Regulatory & Compliance Management**

* Ensure compliance with E‑Waste Management Rules, Hazardous Waste Rules, EPR obligations, and SPCB/CPCB requirements.
* Maintain risk registers, compliance matrices, and legal registers relevant to North India regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate with SPCB/CPCB, auditors, and brand compliance teams for inspections and submissions.
* Ensure proper documentation for manifest tracking, waste storage, disposal, and vendor approvals.

**3. Operational Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Implement in‑process quality checks, sampling plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards for dismantling, segregation, shredding, and ITAD workflows.
* Collaborate with operations to ensure process standardization, error‑proofing, and adherence to SOPs.
* Use data analytics to track NCR trends, defect rates, process deviations, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead training programs for QMS, audit readiness, documentation discipline, and compliance culture.
* Support digitalization of quality workflows (checklists, dashboards, NCR systems).

**4. EHS Support**

* Support implementation of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 within the integrated management system.
* Assist in risk assessments, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, and contractor safety.
* Ensure alignment between quality, environmental, and safety documentation.
* Support waste handling, storage, and disposal compliance as per SPCB norms.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* **Mandatory:**
  Hands‑on experience with
  **ISO 9001**
  and at least one of:
  **ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3, e‑Stewards, IATF 16949**
  .
* 5–7 years of experience in quality systems, audits, and compliance in recycling, e‑waste, ITAD, electronics, automotive, or manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of Indian regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with audit management, documentation systems, and QMS software preferred.
* Quality Systems- ISO 9001, internal audits, CAPA, RCA, FMEA, PDCA.
* Soft Skills - Documentation discipline, stakeholder management, training, cross‑functional collaboration.
* Compliance - EPR, e‑waste rules, hazardous waste rules, SPCB/CPCB norms.
* Technical - SOP writing, sampling plans, inspection methods, traceability.
* Certifications - R2v3, e‑Stewards, ISO 14001/45001, OEM/brand audits.

description:
**Position Title:**
MDM Engineer - Product & Material
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time

43655
  
  
We know the importance that food plays in people's lives – the power it has to bring people, families and communities together. Our purpose is to bring enjoyment to people’s lives through great tasting food, in a way which reflects our values. McCain has recently committed to implementing regenerative agriculture practices across 100 percent of our potato acreage by 2030. Ask us more about our commitment to sustainability.
  
  
**Overview**
As part of McCain digital transformation, we are making significant investments into our data structures and policies to increase the quality of our data, the confidence of our business teams to use this data to make decisions, and to drive value through the use of data.
  
  
We have an ambitious Global Data Governance team, which serves as an enabler to the business teams in our regions and global functions. We are currently recruiting an experienced Master Data Management Technical Process Engineer with strong MDG and ABAP technical understanding to support the governance and quality of Customer and Vendor master data.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The MDM Technical Process Engineer will follow global processes and leverage global tools to govern data in a way that is consistent and standardized across all regions. As a member of the Data and Platform Governance team, this individual will implement and maintain data governance strategies, including enforcement of policies, guidelines, standards, and procedures.
  
  
The position supports Product - Material Master Data Governance within the SAP S/4HANA environment, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and compliance across the organization. Responsibilities include driving data quality initiatives, developing metrics and reports to monitor data integrity, performing root cause analysis of data issues, and contributing to system design improvements.
  
  
The role will also collaborate with SAP technical teams by supporting ABAP code analysis, BADI enhancements, integrations between the MDM platform and S/4 Hana, troubleshooting MDG-related logic and workflows impacting customer and vendor master data.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Maintain master data governance processes from definition through to execution and continuous improvement
* A key responsibility is configuring SimpleMDG modules for vendor and customer master (Product - Material), establishing business rules, approval workflows, and validation logic.
* Implement defined policies and frameworks specifically for vendor and customer master (Product - Material) data governance in the S/4HANA environment.
* Support the implementation of data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms
* Support the integration of master data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms with target systems like S/4 Hana, Salesforce, and the Enterprise Data Platform among others.
* Configure and support SAP MDG for Customer and Vendor Master, including data models, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.
* Perform root cause analysis of data issues and ensure remediation according to data governance policies and standards.
* Develop audit and validation methods to ensure quality of the customer and vendor master data using AI-Driven and automated approaches.
* Assist with regular compliance reviews against policies and standards.
* Identify downstream impacts of master data change.
* Ensure proper monitoring of all integrations between the MDM Platform and other systems.

**Technical & ABAP Responsibilities**

* Analyze and interpret ABAP programs, user exits, BADIs, and enhancements related to Customer master data and SAP MDG processes.
* Support the implementation and enhancement of BADIs and other extension frameworks used in MDG validation, derivation, and workflow logic.
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to analyze custom code and troubleshoot issues affecting master data governance processes.
* Perform technical analysis of SAP tables, CDS views, and data models to support data governance reporting and validation.
* Support debugging and root cause investigation of MDG workflows, rules, and integration issues impacting Customer master data.
* Work with technical teams to ensure custom developments align with MDG governance standards and best practices.
* Assist with impact analysis during system changes, upgrades, or SAP S/4HANA transformations affecting Customer master data structures

**Key Qualification & Experiences**

* Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience with data management/governance, including but not limited to data protection and/or data quality
* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA, Master Data Governance (MDG) including configuration of data models, governance processes, and validations.
* Experience implementing MDM solutions in multiple organizations.
* Working knowledge of ABAP development concepts, including:

+ BADIs and enhancement framework
+ User exits and custom logic analysis
+ Debugging and code review
+ Understanding SAP tables and data models

* A certification like MDG100 will enhance the candite profile.
* Preferred: Experience working with PIM, Data Catalog, Data Governance, and MDM systems.
* Preferred: Understanding of CPG industry specifics — product hierarchies, SKU proliferation, and regulatory data requirements.
* Experience harmonizing systems, processes, and/or data across business areas and functions
* Experience working on an agile team in a virtual, distributed environment
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and participate as an independent contributor with little supervision

title: QA Engineer – AI Applications (Fresher)
description:
**Company Description**
Cosentus is an AI-native revenue cycle management partner that helps healthcare providers reduce denials, improve cash flow, and capture more of their earned revenue through AI-driven technology and specialty-focused RCM expertise. The company manages the full revenue cycle, including credentialing, eligibility, coding, denials, AR follow-up, patient billing, and collections, with a focus on identifying and correcting the root causes of revenue leakage. Cosentus tailors its solutions to each client’s specialty, payer mix, workflows, and goals, offering a transparent and accountable way to manage revenue so providers can focus on patient care. The organization is independently owned and operated, SOC 2 certified, HIPAA compliant, and recognized on the Inc. 5000 and Great Place to Work lists for five consecutive years. Cosentus continues to grow as a trusted partner in healthcare revenue management through its platforms, including cosentus.com and zeushealth.ai.

**Role Description**
The QA Engineer – AI Applications (Fresher) role is a full-time, hybrid position based in New Delhi, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. The individual in this role will execute manual tests for AI-driven applications, validate functionality against requirements, and ensure that software releases meet defined quality standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include creating, reviewing, and maintaining test cases and test documentation, performing regression and functional testing, and reporting defects with clear, reproducible steps. The QA Engineer will collaborate with developers, product owners, and data/AI teams to understand application behavior, verify fixes, and support continuous improvement of testing processes. The role also involves learning and applying QA best practices for AI-powered workflows within healthcare revenue cycle management systems.

Additional Requirement

* Candidates must have their own laptop for work.

Esri is the world leader in geographic information systems (GIS) and developer of ArcGIS, the leading mapping and analytics software used in 75 percent of Fortune 500 companies. At Esri, we believe in helping our customers take on challenging geospatial problems and making a difference in the world. Join our team of talented and passionate engineers and help us build the next generation of ArcGIS Enterprise, a suite of products delivering state-of-the-art geospatial capability to thousands of our customers and millions of users worldwide. Our team builds cutting-edge, highly scalable, and reliable distributed software for on-premises and the cloud. We make maps, geographic information, and analyses available on any device, anywhere, at any time.
  
  
Software Reliability Engineers are responsible for ensuring that the ArcGIS Enterprise product is reliable, highly available, and has powerful disaster recovery features. They do this by gathering user requirements, defining them for the team, evaluating the product, and guiding users through documentation, videos, and presentations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support Esri's strong user-focus by gathering software reliability and availability requirements
* Collect requirements directly from users and indirectly from Esri staff in Support and Professional Services
* Collaborate and influence decisions within and across teams because reliability features and requirements cut across all functionalities
* Prioritize and guarantee software quality by creating test plans, automating those tests, evaluating the results, and ensuring that defects are acted upon
* Communicate effectively with our users through written documentation as well as presentations

**Requirements**

* 2-6 years in a position with operational responsibilities, such as monitoring, maintaining, and deploying enterprise software
* Experience in software testing
* Fundamental understanding of web services, such as REST
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills in a complex backend-server stack
* Effective communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science and applications, math, GIS, geography, or related field
* Existing work authorization for India

**Recommended Qualifications**

* Master's degree in engineering, computer science and applications, math, GIS, geography, or related field
* Experience administering ArcGIS Enterprise
* Experience working directly on a software development team

**The Company**
At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. When employees of different experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures come together, we are more innovative and ultimately a better place to work. We believe in having a diverse workforce that is unified under our mission of creating positive global change. We understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not a destination but an ongoing process. We are committed to the continuation of learning, growing, and changing our workplace so every employee can contribute to their life’s best work. Our commitment to these principles extends to the global communities we serve by creating positive change with GIS technology. For more information on Esri’s Racial Equity and Social Justice initiatives, please visit our website here.
  
  
**If you don’t meet all of the preferred qualifications for this position, we encourage you to still apply!**
Esri is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email askcareers@esri.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this e-mail address.
  
  
Esri Privacy Esri takes our responsibility to protect your privacy seriously. We are committed to respecting your privacy by providing transparency in how we acquire and use your information, giving you control of your information and preferences, and holding ourselves to the highest national and international standards, including CCPA and GDPR compliance.

title: Associate, AI Model Validation, RQA
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Overview**
The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks.  RQA’s principal objectives are to advance the firm’s risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes.
  
  
RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase individual enablement and ultimately build a stronger team. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages collaboration, innovation, diversity and the development our future leaders.  We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strength connect with our purpose.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Risk team within RQA oversees those risks which directly impact the corporate entity (i.e. BlackRock, Inc., or one of its subsidiaries), rather than the fiduciary risks assumed by funds/clients, such as investment risks and counterparty risks. The team’s focus includes but is not limited to operational risk, technology, vendor, model and market risk, stress testing for market risk and the quantitative estimation of capital adequacy requirements.
  
  
The
**AI Validation**
Associate will perform independent reviews of AI tools and agents used across BlackRock, including agentic systems, RAG applications and other business workflows. This role requires strong technical expertise combined with risk management skills to challenge system design, data integrity, and performance monitoring. The role will be based onsite in our GGN office.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct independent validation of AI usage in workflows, including testing for accuracy, efficiency of guardrails, orchestration, memory management and token usage.
* Design and implement comprehensive validation strategies and test plans tailored to each AI use case. Define clear success criteria and quality benchmarks to measure whether the AI solution meets all requirements and standards.
* Understand tool architecture, potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses.
* Assess conceptual soundness, methodology, and alignment with intended business use.
* Review data quality, preprocessing steps and engineering decisions for AI use cases.
* Execute functional and performance tests.
* Evaluate performance metrics, robustness, and limitations under various scenarios.
* Document validation findings, provide recommendations
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies, validation techniques, and regulatory developments.
* Communicate validation conclusions to relevant stakeholders, including escalating identified findings, risks or gaps to senior leadership and approval committees
* Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, and Risk teams to enhance AI transparency and trustworthiness.

**Experience, Skills And Qualification**

* With 3-7 years’ works experience in the IT or financial industry.
* Degree or Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
* Strong understanding of generative AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, prompt engineering, tool use, and modern AI application architectures.
* Experience with Python and common AI development libraries and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar).
* Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and challenge stakeholders constructively.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
* Validating usage of large language models (LLMs) in business context
* Evaluation methodologies, benchmark development, ground-truth creation, and AI quality assessment
* AI observability, monitoring, performance measurement, and operational controls
* AI orchestration frameworks, agent architectures, prompt engineering, memory management, and context optimization
* Exposure to cloud-based AI platforms and scalable model deployment
* MCP, APIs, connectors and integrations of AI solutions with enterprise systems and data sources
* Responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, bias assessment, transparency, and model governance
* Fine-tuning or model customization techniques
* Security testing and risk assessment of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreak, and data leakage testing

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior QE Engineer
description:

Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point-of-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back-office software solutions as well as industry-leading hardware and drive-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech.com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.
  
  
**Position Description**
Senior QE Engineer
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Senior QE Engineer**
with deep expertise in automation and performance testing to help us deliver high-quality software at scale. In this role, you’ll serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on quality practices, design robust test strategies, and contribute to building scalable and reliable systems. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams in a CI/CD environment to drive automation, performance testing, and quality initiatives across the platform.
  
  
**Position Location**
Jaipur/Gurugram
  
  
**Reports To**
Manager QE
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Own performance testing using JMeter or similar tools, identifying system bottlenecks and collaborating with engineering teams to optimize.
* Develop and maintain robust, scalable automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Rest Assured).
* Contribute to test strategy, planning, execution, and reporting.
* Ensure E2E test coverage across UI, API and backend systems.
* Work closely with development teams to identify root causes and provide performance tuning suggestions.
* Identifies opportunities to adopt innovative testing technologies and techniques.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging testing tools and frameworks to improve test efficiency.

**With a Side Of (additional Skills)**

* Exposure to Big Data or AI/ML products.
* Understanding of security testing concepts (OWASP, DAST, SAST) is a plus.

**Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning:**

* 8+ years in quality engineering with strong focus on automation and performance testing.
* Strong knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling).
* Experience with monitoring and profiling tools for performance monitoring.
* Strong in Java/Python/JavaScript based automation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience in CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Solid experience in test, functional testing, system integration testing, regression testing, GUI testing, API/web service testing, and browser compatibility testing
* Familiarity with test management tools like Zephyr
* Deep understanding of software quality best practices, shift-left testing, and test pyramid principles.

**Interview Process**
Interview #1: Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Team
  
  
Interview #2: Video interview with the Technical Teams (via MS Teams/F2F)
  
  
Interview #3: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams/F2F)
  
  
PAR is proud to provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. We also provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, or for your role at PAR, please contact accommodations@partech.com. If you’d like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant, please visit the US Department of Labor's website.

title: QA intern for Medical device Company
description:
**Company Description**
Fidelis Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. manufactures health monitoring, hygiene, and rehabilitation products for the medical device market. The company offers a wide range of “Made in India” devices such as digital BP monitors, digital thermometers, stethoscopes, X-ray illuminators, walking sticks, and oxygen flow meters, all built to global standards. Fidelis Healthcare also produces hygiene solutions including sanitizers and touch-free hand sanitizer dispensers to support safer environments. In addition, the company provides rehabilitation products like bed rests, commode chairs, wheelchairs, blind sticks, and crutches to improve quality of life for diverse user groups. Team members contribute directly to reliable, accessible healthcare products used across India.
  
**Role Description**
The QA Intern role is a full-time, on-site position based in Faridabad. The intern will support day-to-day quality assurance activities for medical devices, including assisting in inspection of incoming materials, in-process checks, and final product verification. Responsibilities include documenting test results, maintaining quality records, helping implement standard operating procedures, and supporting compliance with regulatory and internal quality requirements. The role involves working closely with production and engineering teams to identify non-conformities, participate in root cause analysis, and contribute to corrective and preventive actions. The intern will also assist in preparing reports for audits, updating quality documentation, and learning best practices in medical device quality systems.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Quality Control and Quality Assurance for medical devices.
* Candidates should possess skills in Quality Management and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP).
* Candidates should possess skills in Quality Auditing and basic understanding of regulatory compliance.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and ability to follow documented procedures accurately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills for recording findings and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field.
* Familiarity with medical device standards (e.g., ISO 13485) is an advantage.
* Proficiency in basic office and data tools (e.g., spreadsheets, word processing) for quality documentation and reporting.

title: Product Associate - Apprentice
description:
**Department:**
Product Management
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Apprentice
  
  
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Description**
**About the Program**
The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**To Be Considered For This Apprenticeship, Candidates Must**

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years, OR
* Be in the final year of their degree program and eligible for apprenticeship participation
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**
At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Product Associate, you will work directly within our Gurugram engineering team, helping to shepherd product enhancements and customer-reported issues through Eptura's AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC). You'll connect product priorities and engineering execution, keeping work organized, clearly specified, and moving forward on our Jira kanban boards.
  
  
This is a role for someone who is curious, organized, and eager to learn how great software products are built. You don't need prior experience in product management. You do need strong attention to detail, clear communication, demonstrated capabilities in using AI, and a genuine interest in how technology solves real-world problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain the Jira kanban board: keeping tickets well-organized, clearly described, and appropriately prioritized in collaboration with engineering leads.
* Help triage incoming product enhancement requests and customer-reported defects, gathering the context engineers need to act on them.
* Work with AI to write clear, structured user stories and acceptance criteria that translate business needs into actionable engineering tasks.
* Coordinate with engineers to track progress, surface blockers, and ensure items move efficiently through the AIDLC stages.
* Participate in requirement-gathering conversations with product managers and stakeholders, capturing key decisions and open questions.
* Assist in drafting functional specifications and supporting documentation for new or enhanced product features, also working with AI.
* Support basic testing activities: reviewing completed work against acceptance criteria and flagging discrepancies.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of our AIDLC processes and team ways of working.

**About You**
We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in product or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role:
  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English: you'll be writing tickets, specs, and summaries that engineers and stakeholders rely on.
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information.
* Comfort working in a structured, process-driven environment: you like things to be clear, tracked, and accounted for.
* Curiosity about how software products are built and a willingness to ask questions.
* Familiarity with project or task management tools (Jira experience is a plus).
* A proactive mindset: you spot gaps, follow up, and take ownership of your work.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess AI outputs, identify limitations or risks, and recommend improvements to enhance product value.
* AI-related experience:
* Understanding of AI fundamentals, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, automation workflows, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity: research, data analysis, content creation, or workflow automation, either through academic, personal, or professional projects. Ability to build and demonstrate an AI agent.
* Ability to evaluate Ai-driven product opportunities, gathering feedback and translating it into feature recommendations.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to agile or kanban workflows (even in an academic or personal project context).
* Basic understanding of software development concepts: you don't need to code, but knowing what engineers do helps.
* Prior internship, project, or coursework related to business analysis, product management, or software delivery.

**Benefits**

* Monthly stipend
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Hyrid working policy
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information**

* Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube
* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
We are seeking an experienced QA Engineer (Manual & Automation) with strong expertise across web, mobile, and API testing. The ideal candidate possesses a solid foundation in manual testing, extensive hands-on automation skills, strong analytical abilities, and the capability to take ownership of end-to-end quality for assigned features. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams and continuous improvement of testing processes, frameworks, and automation coverage.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Develop and document comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automation scripts based on functional and technical requirements.
* Execute manual and automated tests to validate software functionality, usability, API responses, and overall system stability.
* Build, enhance, and maintain automation test suites for web, mobile, and API platforms.
* Accurately report, track, and manage defects using JIRA, ensuring clear and concise communication with the development team.
* Take ownership of end-to-end quality for assigned modules/features and ensure timely delivery of high-quality releases.
* Perform regression testing to ensure new changes do not adversely impact existing functionality.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, designers, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and provide early feedback.
* Maintain detailed documentation of test cases, test results, and QA processes for traceability and reproducibility.
* Contribute to the improvement of automation frameworks to increase test reliability and coverage.
* Utilize AI tools to accelerate test case creation, script optimization, analysis, and documentation.
* Stay updated with emerging QA trends, tools, automation technologies, and industry best practices to drive continuous improvement.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in manual and automation testing for web applications, mobile apps, and APIs.
* Strong hands-on experience with web automation using Playwright with Typescript and mobile automation using Appium.
* Experience with API testing and automation using Postman, Newman, or Rest Assured.
* Minimum 2 years of recent, continuous experience in Web and API automation
* Proficient in at least two programming languages used for automation, such as TypeScript, Java, Python, or C#.
* Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
* Experience in performance testing (load, stress, API performance) is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience with test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Skilled in using AI-driven QA tools to speed up test design, data generation, defect analysis, and documentation.
* Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working in cross-functional Agile teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues early.
* Exceptional attention to detail, ensuring accurate testing and effective detection of defects.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for collaboration with global and cross-functional teams.
* ISTQB or other relevant QA certifications would be an advantage.

**About The Team**
In the central Digital Products and Solutions (DPS) organization, our Software Application and Engineering department is responsible for developing software solutions for both internal and external customers.
  
  
In DPS, our software products already cover a wide range of categories, and we see many opportunities for growth: Asset Performance Management, Energy Management, Asset Monitoring, Asset Health Prediction, Customer Portal & AI-assisted Applications, Connectivity & Edge, Backend Core / Domain / Platform Services, and Professional Services.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 92,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making balanced, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
"Let’s make tomorrow different today" is our genuine dedication at Siemens Energy to all customers and employees on the way to a balanced future.
  
  
Check out this video to learn more about Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Regards**

title: Service Quality Specialist III
description:
**About The Role And Team**
Community Operations at Uber is focused on delivering consistent, reliable, and high-quality support experiences. As a
**Service Quality Specialist**
, you will play a key role in driving quality calibration, evaluator alignment, and continuous improvement across our global BPO and COE networks.
  
  
You will work closely with Quality, Operations, Learning & Development, and cross-functional teams to ensure consistent application of Uber's quality standards, identify performance gaps, and translate insights into actionable improvements. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to influence quality outcomes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Drive Calibration and Alignment: Support site-level calibrations, resolve scoring disputes, and ensure consistent application of Quality@Uber (Q@U) standards across BPO sites.
* Strengthen Audit Accuracy: Conduct Audit-the-Auditor (ATA) reviews, identify scoring inconsistencies, and provide feedback to improve evaluator accuracy and alignment.
* Analyze Quality Performance: Leverage quality dashboards, calibration results, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends, scoring variance, and coaching opportunities.
* Generate Actionable Insights: Conduct root cause analysis and recommend targeted interventions to improve quality performance and customer experience.
* Improve Cross-BPO Consistency: Compare quality performance across sites, identify gaps, and drive alignment through focused coaching and calibration.
* Drive Closed-Loop Improvements: Partner with stakeholders to address recurring knowledge base, policy, tooling, and process gaps, ensuring corrective actions are tracked to resolution.
* Maintain Quality Standards: Build and maintain benchmark cases and standardized scoring rationales to reinforce consistent evaluations.
* Communicate Quality Impact: Share calibration trends, performance insights, and improvement outcomes with stakeholders to support data-driven decisions.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ year of experience in quality assurance, customer support, or operational auditing.
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting performance data and identifying improvement opportunities.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides).
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* High school diploma or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in quality calibration, audit governance, or performance management within BPO operations.
* Familiarity with Q@U, Observe.AI , or similar quality management platforms.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis, resolving scoring disputes, and driving process improvements.
* Ability to influence stakeholders, manage ambiguity, and work effectively across global teams.
* Understanding of customer satisfaction, quality compliance, and operational performance metrics.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Quality Insights Lead
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
The Quality Insights Lead (QIL) supports the daily operations of the Quality program, setting a high standard for quality across the Customer Support (CS) organization. Reporting to the Quality Manager, the QIL drives continuous improvement through Quality initiatives, including analysis, business case development, reporting on Quality monitoring, and applying Problem Solving Methodologies. They ensure all assigned tasks are completed on time, collaborate with other CS teams as the Quality representative, and may oversee Quality Partner sites as needed. The QIL also serves as a brand ambassador, upholding exceptional customer service standards.
  
  
**A Typical Day**

* Provide daily support for Quality programs.

* Execute QI and ad-hoc after-action reviews.
* Use transaction monitoring insights to develop targeted continuous improvement initiatives for customer service enhancements.

* Convert machine-generated insights from AI-assisted monitoring into strategic service enhancements and targeted coaching priorities.
* Participate in and lead global calibration sessions with internal and partner teams to standardize Quality monitoring and Problem Solving methodologies.
* Provide feedback on coaching effectiveness for internal and partner Team Leads, fostering a coaching culture.
* Coach CS agents to achieve Quality program standards.
* Act as the Quality representative for other CS teams (e.g., CM, BPI, Training) and contribute to relevant projects.
* Collect, analyze, and propose changes derived from Support Ambassador roundtable insights at internal and partner sites.
* Travel to partner sites to implement, train, and run key QA initiatives (e.g., onboarding workshops, certifications).
* Master CS policies, procedures, and workflows, ensuring timely knowledge updates for regional QIA teams.
* Conduct spot checks on Quality Analysts and report findings to their QA Leads/Managers.
* Recommend actions to improve based on QA dashboard outcomes.
* Upskill in relevant or new service tiers when needed.
* Lead Quality at partner sites if required.

**Your Expertise**

* Technical & Analytical Depth; strong analytical, statistical, and automation background — able to design and build AI-enabled tooling that streamlines review processes while maintaining rigor and high-quality analysis.
* Pursuing Excellence; setting the highest standards for the quality of work produced while holding yourself and others accountable
* Collaborative; skilled working with cross-functional peers/teams
* Presenting and Influencing; ability to develop action plans, business cases and data driven reporting that you would present to all levels of the organization
* Coaching; You objectively analyze performance and provide regular feedback. You modify your approach to suit your audience. Ability to maintain high levels of confidentiality while providing analysis and coaching.Maintain high levels of confidentiality while performing analysis and coaching
* Solving Problems; You quickly identify root causes as well as subtle, hidden issues. You use logic to propose effective solutions to a variety of problems. You dig deeper and utilize all available resources to reach the best possible solution.
* Managing Time Efficiently; You prioritize correctly, focusing your efforts on the things that are most important. You stay organized to ensure successful multitasking.

**Role Requirements**

* 4-6 years of Customer Experience management experience in a rapidly growing partner network
* Experience working in a QA Specialist or related role
* Working knowledge of contact center end to end processes
* Working knowledge of customer service assessment tools, i.e., Net Promoter System
* Working knowledge of google suite, including sheets
* Experience leading, inspiring and motivating others to meet goals and metrics
* Passionate about setting a high bar of exceptional customer service
* Highly-developed analytical and critical-thinking skills
* Ability to spot trends in data and provide recommended actions to drive performance
* Experience with AI automation workflows within contact center Quality environments; includes validating AI-generated outputs, identifying anomalies, and interpreting model-driven trends to formulate actionable service improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to obtain COPC certification
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Travel to partner sites expected up to 20%
* Work with Operations teams in the region to address escalated issues, dips in performance and the roll out of new Quality initiatives to drive performance.

**Prefer To Have**

* Exceptional coaching abilities
* Advanced knowledge of Excel or Google Docs
* Strong knowledge of NPS and Quality tools (e.g. Medallia)
* Hands-on experience utilizing Observe.AI or equivalent AI-driven conversation intelligence solutions, specifically involving speech analytics, automated scoring, and real-time guidance.
* Expertise in market-leading contact center Quality Assurance platforms and global program frameworks.
* Proven ability to operate alongside AI automation workflows; includes assessing AI-facilitated customer interactions, pinpointing model anomalies, and converting machine-generated insights into strategic service enhancements.
* Quality Assurance certification (e.g. COPC)
* Ability to create and deliver presentations to the organization

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
India Annual Pay Range
  
  
₹1,610,000—₹2,110,000 INR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

In this role, you will help manage the company’s BlackLine platform by providing functional and configuration support for onboarding new affiliated transactions and maintaining existing ones, with a strong focus on financial close automation, intercompany processes, and journal entry governance.
  
  
This role offers broad exposure to enterprise finance operations and places them at the forefront of an evolving financial close environment. The responsibilities are closely aligned with BlackLine-related disciplines, including automation, control execution, audit readiness, and process optimization.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Lead the review and analysis of BlackLine incidents, ensuring naming conventions, downstream system requirements, and financial close controls are consistently maintained
* Partner with finance and controllership teams to design and maintain BlackLine configurations that support compliance and the onboarding of new and existing affiliated transactions
* Provide subject matter expertise in BlackLine controls, configurations, and financial close oversight
* Participate in enterprise finance transformation initiatives with an emphasis on BlackLine optimization, including process standardization, automation opportunities, and enhancements that improve efficiency and visibility
* Lead with a product and platform mindset by shaping the vision for BlackLine and related finance platforms, influencing stakeholders, and identifying opportunities to enhance platform capabilities, adoption, and business value
* Contribute to roadmap planning and continuous improvement efforts for BlackLine, supporting intercompany processes and financial close activities

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree is required; a degree in Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field is preferred
* 3+ years of practical experience in business analysis, finance systems, financial close, or related accounting and reporting processes is preferred
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess process gaps, control requirements, and dependencies across finance systems
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with accounting, finance, and technology stakeholders
* Exposure to BlackLine modules such as Intercompany Hub, Transaction Matching, or Journal Entry would be highly valuable
* Experience with Oracle ERP (particularly General Ledger) is a plus

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities across system enhancements, maintenance activities, and project deliverables while meeting deadlines
* Ability to learn quickly, work independently, and collaborate effectively in a diverse team environment

* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)

* Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Microsoft Power BI for close reporting, reconciliation monitoring, or operational dashboards is a plus

AlzaSyno Life Sciences is a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing end-to-end services to pharmaceutical, bio-pharmaceutical, medical device, and Ayurvedic organizations. AlzaSyno also offers specialized medical writing for clinical documentation and regulatory submissions, along with regulatory affairs support to develop strategy, prepare filings, and act as liaison with global regulatory agencies. Professionals joining AlzaSyno contribute to streamlined, compliant clinical research and product development across diverse healthcare sectors.

The role involves investigating deviations and non-conformances, coordinating corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, medical writing, and regulatory affairs. * Strong knowledge of GxP (such as GCP, GLP), ISO, ISMS, DPDP, clinical research regulations, and industry guidelines relevant to pharmaceuticals and medical devices.
* Excellent attention to detail, analytical skills, and ability to interpret and apply regulatory and quality requirements in practice.
* Effective communication and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and present quality findings clearly.

title: Lead Quality Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**The Role: Lead Quality Engineer**
**The Team**
Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements.
  
  
Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions.
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability.
  
  
**The Impact**
As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality.
  
  
This role requires strong technical expertise, a solid understanding of financial risk platforms, and the ability to lead quality initiatives across agile delivery teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously improve the quality strategy across the full software development lifecycle, embedding effective quality gates from requirements and design through release and production support.
* Shift quality engineering from defect detection to defect prevention by identifying risks, control gaps, and testability concerns early in the delivery process.
* Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable automated test frameworks covering UI, API, data, integration, regression, and other relevant testing areas.
* Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test suites based on software requirements, technical specifications, business workflows, and real-world customer usage.
* Drive risk-based testing for financial risk platforms, prioritising coverage for regulatory workflows, calculation accuracy, data integrity, security controls, system integration, and customer-critical journeys.
* Design and implement test automation using Java, Python, Selenium, Cucumber, Carina, and other appropriate technologies and frameworks.
* Establish and monitor quality engineering standards and metrics, including automation coverage, defect leakage, release readiness, test reliability, environment stability, and production incident feedback.
* Champion continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines by integrating reliable and efficient automated validation into build, deployment, and release processes.
* Improve release confidence and operational resilience by validating deployment readiness, rollback capability, observability, environment consistency, and applicable non-functional requirements.
* Lead quality governance for agile teams, ensuring that acceptance criteria, test evidence, sign-offs, and release risks are clearly documented, auditable, and decision-ready.
* Manage and support QA and UAT environments, build deployments, test data, test execution, release planning, and testing sign-off activities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support to resolve quality issues and strengthen end-to-end software reliability.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand business impact and translate workflow complexity and customer needs into effective test coverage.
* Use AI and modern engineering practices to improve QA productivity through intelligent test generation, defect analysis, regression optimisation, log analysis, and test data creation.
* Mentor QA engineers and influence developers to build quality into their work by promoting automation, code quality, testability, maintainability, and shared ownership.
* Perform gap analysis across application and platform test coverage and define remediation plans to address identified risks.
* Balance manual and automated testing based on delivery needs, while continuously moving toward automation-first and analytics-driven quality engineering.
* Act as a technical leader and subject-matter expert, proactively resolving issues, managing risks, and escalating concerns appropriately.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.
* 10 plus years of work experience across software quality engineering and end-to-end testing activities, including experience in a technical leadership or lead QA capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience with automation and white-box testing using Java, Python, or both.
* Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Carina, or equivalent web-testing frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience with API and web services testing, including the development or use of API automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases; knowledge of PL/SQL, NoSQL databases, and Linux/UNIX environments is desirable.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with build and deployment processes.
* Understanding of performance, integration, regression, data, security, and non-functional testing practices.
* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues across application, data, and platform layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present quality risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed agile teams.
* Ability to operate independently, take ownership, influence engineering decisions, and drive quality improvements across the organisation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with capital markets, financial risk analytics, counterparty credit risk, xVA, market risk, or related financial services platforms.
* Experience testing calculation-intensive, data-intensive, or regulatory applications.
* Knowledge of cloud-deployed applications, containers, microservices, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
* Experience applying AI-enabled tools and modern engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and quality outcomes.
* Experience establishing quality metrics, governance processes, and continuous improvement programmes for engineering teams.

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Global Supply Management (GSM) is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and contracting with the right suppliers to meet business needs and enable the enterprise to pay for the goods and services procured from its suppliers and partners (co-brand, corporate card clients, membership rewards, service establishment rebates and travel & lifestyle). Besides providing third party risk management, it is also responsible for managing the Travel and Entertainment (T&E) program for the enterprise.
  
  
**Function Description**
The Amex offers various co-branded credit cards, issued in partnership with another company, often a brand known for a specific product or service. A prime example of an Amex co-brand is the Delta SkyMiles Blue American Express Card, which offers perks like travel rewards and enhanced benefits for Delta fliers. The Amex Co-brand Compliance team is responsible for the timely review of co-brand Partner payments, ensure 100% accuracy to payment process, identify risk and develop remediation plan. We are looking for a detail oriented and process driven Quality review analyst to support the execution of quality checks and risk reviews across the process. This role is critical in ensuring adherence to payment guidelines and risk mitigation frameworks. The Analyst will be responsible for performing quality reviews, identifying compliance gaps, document findings and supporting root cause analysis to drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform quality reviews of Co-brand Partner payments and maintain high accuracy & timelines.
* Identify process errors, exceptions or deviations from standard operating procedures.
* Maintain accurate and well-organized documentation of quality review observations.
* Prepare and share quality review reports, dashboards and noncompliance logs with key stakeholders.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to validate payment and seek clarification where discrepancy exist.
* Track and follow-up on corrective and preventive actions items and ensure timely closure.
* Assist in updating quality control checklist and SOPs based on process changes.
* Support various Audits, providing back-up documentation and evidence for the reviews performed.
* Escalate high risk or repeat compliance issues to Senior team members or Manager.

**Leadership Skills**

* Risk and Compliance awareness.
* Excellent relationship and influence management skills with the ability to build productive relationships across teams and levels of seniority.
* Self-confident with a keen sense of integrity and the ability and willingness to challenge and be challenged.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Risk management or related field.
* 2-4 years of experience in Compliance, Audit, Quality review roles.
* Candidate must have strong quality review experience of end-to-end Accounts Payable and have worked for at least 2-3 years in quality review team of Payment processes.
* Excellent documentation, analytical and communication skills.
* Strong working knowledge and experience of ERP applications including Oracle (both sub-ledger and general ledger)
* Excellent relationship management and collaboration with stakeholders.
* Excellent problem solving, conflict resolution and analytical skills.
* Exceptional communication skills – verbal, written and through presentations. Ability to break down complex ideas into clear and actionable messages.
* Highly motivated individual with an ability to drive results and work with ambiguity.
* Ability to handle multiple deliverables with aggressive deadlines.
* Take responsibility and work with minimal supervision, as well as have excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

title: ENGINEER WARRANTY DATA ANALYSIS
description:
**About Us**
At CNH, we're driven by a clear purpose:
**we serve and advance the people who feed and build a growing world.**
As a global leader in agriculture and construction, we create the equipment, technology, and solutions that help our customers work more productively and sustainably. Our success starts with our people, and we foster a collaborative culture where innovation thrives and every employee has the opportunity to grow.
  
  
**Grow a Career. Build a Future.**
If you're ready to make an impact and build a career with purpose, there's a place for you at CNH.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The
**Data Analyst – AG Products Warranty & Telematics**
role is responsible for analyzing warranty, telematics, and engineering performance data to identify product quality trends, drive continuous improvement, and support data-driven decision-making across Agricultural (AG) products. The position collaborates closely with Product Engineering, Current Product Teams, Manufacturing, and other stakeholders to monitor key quality and performance KPIs, including F100, ACPU, and engineering effectiveness metrics. The role focuses on reviewing, categorizing, and interpreting warranty failure data, telematics insights, hydraulic system performance, ADPU, NPS, and other operational datasets to support product development and quality improvement initiatives. Additionally, the position is responsible for analyzing telemetry and Telemaco data from multiple platforms to enhance product reliability, customer experience, and service support, while also contributing to the development and maintenance of engineering content management solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collect, validate, and analyze warranty, telematics, ADPU, NPS, and quality data to identify failure patterns, product performance trends, and customer-impacting issues.
* Perform trend, Pareto, root-cause, and predictive analytics to prioritize quality improvements and support Strategic Development Projects (SDPs).
* Develop dashboards, KPI reports, and analytical solutions (F100, ACPU, warranty, quality, and engineering performance metrics) to enable data-driven decision-making.
* Execute projects leveraging Power Apps, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and automation technologies to improve productivity, quality, and business processes.
* Partners with Product Engineering, Current Product Management, and Manufacturing teams to investigate issues, support in implementing corrective actions, and enhance product reliability.
* Analyze vehicle telemetry and usage data from multiple platforms to identify opportunities for product enhancements, predictive insights, customer support, and service optimization.
* Design and maintain enterprise data solutions, automated workflows, Power Apps, and reporting platforms that integrate diverse data sources and streamline operations.
* Advance analytics, AI/ML capabilities, automation, data governance, and engineering content management practices to increase efficiency, accuracy, and business value.
* Transform complex data into actionable intelligence, enabling fact-based decisions, continuous improvement, and quality excellence across global AG product lines.

**Experience Required**

* Experience in Advanced Analytics, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence Solutions.
* Experience working with Python, Databricks, SQL, Power BI, Power Query, Excel, Power Apps, and Qlik Sense.
* Support in developing and deploying Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions.
* Experience working with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, cloud-based data platforms, and data lake environments.
* Strong understanding of KPI management, dashboard development, reporting automation, and data visualization techniques.
* Experience in working on data like telematics, warranty, engineering performance, bill of material or quality.
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure databrick, and enterprise reporting ecosystems is preferred.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* 2 to 6 years of prior work experience in data analysis using statistical tools and providing inferences along with recommendations

**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical / Electrical / Computer Science) or similar
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.
  
  
At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits.

**Qualifications & Experience**
